title: Teamleder social og anbringelse, Center for Familier, Unge og Tidlig indsats
description:
Vil du stå tæt på både mennesker, faglighed og de svære beslutninger?

Vi søger en teamleder til Social- og Anbringelsesteamet i Familieafdelingen i Center for Familier, Unge og Tidlig Indsats.

Som teamleder for Social- og Anbringelsesteamet bliver du leder for medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med nogle af de børn, unge og familier, som har brug for mest fra os. Det er et område med høj faglig kompleksitet, stort ansvar og beslutninger, der kan få afgørende betydning i et barns liv.

Derfor leder vi efter dig, der både kan stå sikkert i myndighedsopgaven og være tæt på de mennesker, der skal lykkes med den.

En del af noget nyt

Center for Familier, Unge og Tidlig Indsats er et nyt center i Lejre Kommune. Vi har samlet en række indsatser omkring børn, unge og familier, fordi vi vil skabe stærkere forbindelser mellem vores fagligheder og mere sammenhæng i de forløb, børn og familier møder.

Familieafdelingen består af Familiehuset og Tidlig Indsats, Specialteamet samt Social- og Anbringelsesteamet.

Som teamleder bliver du en del af ledelsen i Familieafdelingen sammen med afdelingslederen og de øvrige teamledere. I skal sammen sikre en afdeling med stærk faglighed, tydelig retning og en drift, vi har styr på – men også være nysgerrige på, hvad vi kan gøre bedre og anderledes.

Vi er i gang med at bygge vores nye organisering. Det betyder, at ikke alt er støbt i beton. Til gengæld er der reel mulighed for at få indflydelse på, hvordan vi skal arbejde og lede sammen.

Du skal tæt på praksis

Vi tror på, at god ledelse på myndighedsområdet kræver nærhed.

Du skal kende dit team, kende opgaven og have blik for, hvor der er brug for din ledelse. Nogle dage handler det om faglig sparring i en vanskelig sag. Andre dage om prioritering, økonomi, arbejdsmiljø, rettidighed eller om at hjælpe et team med at holde retningen, når der er meget på spil.

Du får personale- og fagligt ledelsesansvar for Social- og Anbringelsesteamet og ansvar for, at der er sammenhæng mellem høj socialfaglig kvalitet og en stabil drift.

Det betyder blandt andet, at du skal:

  • være tæt på medarbejderne og tilgængelig for faglig sparring, prioritering og beslutninger
  • sætte en tydelig faglig retning og understøtte kvalitet, systematik og rettidighed i myndighedsarbejdet
  • have blik for teamets opgaver og belastning og bidrage til en god prioritering af ressourcerne
  • skabe rum for faglig refleksion, læring og udvikling
  • have fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og et bæredygtigt arbejdsmiljø
  • understøtte et godt samarbejde med børn, unge og familier og med de fagligheder, der er omkring dem
  • bidrage til sammenhæng og samarbejde på tværs af Familieafdelingen og centeret.
  • indgå i den ledelsesmæssige døgnbagvagt, som varetages på skift sammen med dine lederkolleger.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan stå fast uden at stå stille

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Men du skal have et solidt socialfagligt fundament og forstå den myndighedsopgave, du skal lede.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse og erfaring fra myndighedsområdet for børn og unge. Du har ledelseserfaring – eller har på anden måde vist, at du kan tage tydeligt fagligt og organisatorisk ansvar og er klar til at træde ind i en egentlig ledelsesrolle.

Det vigtigste for os er, hvordan du går til ledelsesopgaven.

Vi håber, at du er en leder, der tør være tydelig, også når noget er vanskeligt. At du kan træffe beslutninger uden at tro, at du altid selv har svaret. At du er oprigtigt nysgerrig på medarbejdernes faglighed, og at du kan skabe ro, retning og følgeskab i en hverdag, hvor prioriteringer nogle gange skal foretages hurtigt.

Du skal kunne bevæge dig mellem detaljen og det store billede. Mellem den konkrete sag og mønstrene på tværs. Mellem hensynet til barnet, familien, medarbejderne, fagligheden, lovgivningen og de ressourcer, vi har til rådighed.

Og så skal du have lyst til at lede sammen med andre.

For vi tror ikke på, at de vigtigste udfordringer omkring børn og familier kan løses inden for én faglighed eller én organisatorisk kasse.

Det får du hos os

Du kommer ind i en organisation, der er i bevægelse, og hvor ambitionerne for børn, unge og familier er høje.

Du får en afdelingsleder tæt på dig og lederkolleger, som du skal udvikle Familieafdelingen sammen med. Du bliver samtidig en del af et nyt center, hvor vi arbejder målrettet på at skabe stærkere forbindelser mellem myndighed, behandling, tidlige indsatser, ungeområdet og de sundhedsfaglige tilbud.

Vi lover ikke, at opgaven er enkel.

Til gengæld lover vi, at den er vigtig.

Og at du får mulighed for at sætte et tydeligt aftryk på både dit team, Familieafdelingen, Centeret og den måde, vi fremover skaber sammenhæng omkring børn, unge og familier i Lejre Kommune.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Hvis du er blevet nysgerrig på stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Camilla Lentz på telefon 24659407

Ansøgningsfrist: 21. oktober 2026
Samtaler: 1. samtale afholdes 27. oktober 2026. 2. samtale afholdes 29. oktober
Tiltrædelse: 1. december 2026

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi glæder os til at høre, hvad du kan bringe med ind i opgaven.

Lejre Kommune er et fællesskab af 49 små byer og landsbyer. Her bor lige under 30.000 mennesker, og stadig flere kommer til. Som kommune arbejder vi for at skabe det gode liv på landet, nu og for fremtidige generationer. Det handler om at tænke naturen ind i alt, hvad vi laver. At finde løsningerne i fællesskab og fællesskaber, og at skabe frirum, hvor borgere, foreninger og virksomheder kan udfolde sig.

Vi har i alt omkring 2000 medarbejdere, som arbejder for at skabe velfærd i et nært samarbejde med alle dem, som indsatsen har betydning for.

Det er derfor, vi kalder Lejre Kommune for Vores Sted.

I Lejre Kommune er der røgfri arbejdstid.

I Lejre Kommune indhenter vi straffeattester og børneattester til en række stillinger. Vær derfor opmærksom på, at du kan blive bedt om at give tilladelse til indhentning af disse, i de stillinger hvor det er relevant.

title: Senior Legal Coordinator
description:
Join AWI Management Corporation as our Senior Legal Coordinator

If you like keeping complicated matters organized, deadlines honest, and everyone informed, this role is for you. AWI Management Corporation is a property management company focused on affordable housing, with roughly 270 sites across seven western states. As our Senior Legal Coordinator, you will be the central point of contact for the legal actions, regulatory complaints, and insurance matters that come out of our property operations.

About the role

Location: Roseville, CA
Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 40 hours per week

Starting Range: $34.50 to $38.50
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

You will manage and track property-related injury claims, unlawful detainers, and complaints filed with the California Civil Rights Department (CRD) under the Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA), along with the company's property insurance coverage and policies. You will work directly with our tenant/landlord legal counsel, insurance carriers, regulatory agencies, and external insurance counsel, and make sure every matter is documented, tracked, and moving forward. You will also report on claim status to our Chief Executive Officer and give informal guidance to the Legal Coordinator, a peer who reports to the same leader you do.

What you'll do

• Serve as the first point of contact for incoming legal actions and complaints, including injury claims, unlawful detainers, and CRD/FEHA complaints.

• Track every claim and case from start to finish, and keep a system for deadlines, action items, and follow-ups so nothing slips.

• Work with insurance carriers and adjusters on injury claims, making sure documentation is submitted and tracked, and keep internal teams updated on status.

• Maintain the insurance coverage database: confirm policies are in force across the portfolio, track renewal dates, confirm premium invoices are paid, and keep certificates of insurance current.

• Communicate with regulatory agencies, outside counsel, and other involved parties, and build strong working relationships with adjusters, attorneys, and government agencies.

• Keep all legal and insurance records complete, confidential, and organized in our centralized case management database.

• Research laws, policies, and insurance procedures to support claims, litigation, and regulatory matters, and help ensure matters are handled in line with housing laws, regulations, and company policy.

• Prepare regular reports on open claims and legal actions for the CEO and senior management.

• Guide and support the Legal Coordinator, share knowledge so matters are handled consistently, and provide additional administrative support to the COO and legal team as needed.

What you'll bring

Required

• A paralegal certificate from an accredited institution, or equivalent work experience.

• At least 2 years in a paralegal or legal support role, preferably in real estate, property management, or housing law.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

• Strong working knowledge of legal terminology, property management practices, and housing laws.

Preferred

• Experience with insurance claims, unlawful detainers (evictions), and CRD complaints.

• Experience leading, training, or mentoring a team member.

• Experience with property management software such as Yardi.

Skills that will help you succeed

• Strong organization and the ability to prioritize and manage many cases at once.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including with attorneys, adjusters, and government agencies.

• Close attention to detail with deadlines and legal documentation.

• Sound judgment, professionalism, and a firm commitment to confidentiality.

• The ability to work independently and as part of a team, and to guide a colleague without formal supervisory authority.

Work environment

This is primarily an office-based position with extended periods of computer work, frequent phone and email communication, and regular handling of confidential legal and insurance records. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Equal opportunity employer

AWI Management Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

This job ad describes the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications, and duties may change as business needs require.

title: Claims Director
description:
Central Coast Salary Range: $174,547 - $261,821

While candidates from anywhere in California are welcome to apply, there is a strong preference for those who reside on the Central Coast (Ventura, Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo, Monterey and Santa Cruz Counties). This role may offer opportunities for remote work; however, familiarity with and proximity to our local customers is valued.

Job Summary

This position directs the functions of the Claims Department, providing strategic, operational, and transformational leadership for claims adjudication, claims support services, encounter data, and overall claims operations. The Director is responsible for optimizing end-to-end claims processes, leveraging technology and automation, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, accuracy, regulatory compliance, provider satisfaction, and organizational performance.

The Claims Director is responsible for the overall staffing, planning, fiscal management, administration, and operation of all claims functions, programs and activities. The Director ensures that all claims functions meet or exceed regulatory, compliance, and timely service requirements, and that customer service and support is of the highest quality. The Director ensures claims are processed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations through effective operational oversight, quality standards, and performance management. This role leads enterprise claims transformation initiatives that improve performance, reduce administrative burden, and increase automation.

The Director provides leadership for establishing and optimizing production workflows, quality standards, operating policies, procedures, and claims processing guidelines. The role collaborates across the organization to ensure claims operations support business, financial, operational, and reporting objectives while advancing CenCal Health's strategic goals.

Serves as a member of CenCal Health’s senior leadership team and collaborates with the other departments to develop and implement strategies which support the provider network. Develops strong relationships with internal and external partners and implements efficient and effective operational processes that enhance organizational performance.

This position reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer in the Operations Division and is responsible for the complete oversight of the Claims Department.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership to the Claims Department and establish objectives which ensure that the department goals and objectives are met and that customer service to the provider network is at the forefront of all department operations.
  • Supervise directly reporting staff.
  • Oversee the interpretation and implementation of State and Federal statutes, regulations and mandates (including NCQA, HEDIS, HIPAA, Knox Keene, DHCS, DMHC, CMS) pertinent to claims processing function, while improving claims processes to yield operational efficiencies.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Medicare claims operations and payment requirements, ensuring operational readiness, compliance, and scalability for existing and future Medicare products and programs.
  • Ensure the timely, accurate configuration of the claims system including ongoing auditing to identify and implement areas for improvement.
  • Oversee the timely and accurate implementation of benefits, provider payment rate updates, and dispute/appeal handling processes.
  • Create updated Department policies and procedures as necessary.
  • Ensure the efficient, timely, and accurate adjudication of claims; revising operating workflows, and other necessary changes to effectively implement changing policies and procedures.
  • Lead continuous process improvement initiatives utilizing data analytics, workflow redesign, automation, and best practices to improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and enhance claims accuracy and turnaround times.
  • Develop and execute a long-term operational strategy for claims modernization, including implementation of automation tools, artificial intelligence-enabled workflows where appropriate, system enhancements, and streamlined business processes.
  • Enhance operational performance metrics and dashboards to monitor productivity, quality, and service outcomes; use data to drive decision-making and resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with Configuration on the timely, accurate configuration and optimization of the claims platform, ensuring technology solutions support efficient workflows, regulatory compliance, payment integrity, and organizational objectives.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor programs and procedures to assure the efficient and timely submission of accurate encounter data.
  • Oversee the volume and financial impact of pended claims, and status of subsystems maintained by Claims staff
  • Ensure staff is advised of all procedural changes in a timely manner, and that such changes are implemented promptly and effectively.
  • Direct the claims service functions and claims mailroom to ensure that responses to provider inquiries, disputes or appeals, and internal inquiries are resolved accurately, promptly and with a high level of customer service.
  • Ensure responsive and proactive individual and group training for hospitals and other providers on claims processes in coordination with the Provider Services or Provider Relations Department.
  • Implement any policy or regulatory changes in a timely and compliant manner.
  • Provide monthly Board reports and statistics related to claims adjudication or service activities; ensure accuracy of statistical data submitted.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, IT, Provider Services, Health Services, Configuration, and other necessary departments to ensure that the claims payment system is configured and maintained appropriately to support accurate claims processing and adhere to state and federal regulatory requirements.
  • Manage vendors used to support claims processing and auditing including, but not limited to, reviewing contracts, establishing and managing performance expectations, periodically surveying market for alternative vendors and participate in due diligence and annual delegation audits.
  • Ensure timely recruitment, retention, training and development of qualified claims staff.
  • Oversee any delegated functions related to claims, including ongoing monitoring, reporting, and corrective action, as needed.
  • Develop and cultivate a culture to promote the best workplace experience for department employees.
  • Contributes as a key member of the Senior Leadership Team and committees, addressing the strategic goals of the department and organization.
  • Delegates and monitors progress on achieving key metrics, key initiatives and project goals, staff productivity, expense management.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

title: GIS Specialist
description:
Als GIS Specialist bij BESIX speel je een cruciale rol in het beheren, analyseren en visualiseren van ruimtelijke gegevens ter ondersteuning van bouwprojecten in België en Frankrijk (remote). Je werkt samen met diverse teams, waaronder ingenieurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiders en ontwerpers, om geografische informatie efficiënt te gebruiken in operationele- en besluitvormingsprocessen.

Je zal werken in het team Informatiemanagement onder de leiding van de BIM/GIS Manager. Daarnaast zal je ook nauw samenwerken met de andere GIS en BIM collega’s van BESIX België en Nederland.

Verantwoordelijkheden en taken:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van GIS-kaarten, datasets en applicaties voor lopende en toekomstige projecten in België en in het buitenland.
  • Analyseren en visualiseren van geografische informatie om inzicht te geven in projectgebieden.
  • Integreren van GIS-data met BIM-modellen en andere technische systemen.
  • Automatiseren van ruimtelijke analyses en dataverwerking met Python, FME of andere GIS-tools.
  • Samenwerken met teams in Nederland en België om best practices en data-uitwisseling te optimaliseren.
  • Bachelor of Master -diploma in Geo-informatica of een ander relevant vakgebied.
  • Minimaal 3+ jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke rol.
  • Ervaring binnen de bouwsector op grootschalige (>25 miljoen) of complexe infrastructuurprojecten is een pluspunt.
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring met ArcGIS Pro.
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring met Python en FME.
  • Werkervaring met ArcGIS Online en/of ArcGIS Enterprise.
  • Werkervaring met (Enterprise) Geodatabases.
  • Werkervaring met BIM gerelateerde data is een pluspunt.
  • Werkervaring met dronedata is een pluspunt.
  • Werkervaring met GIS in relatie tot andere informatiesystemen, bijvoorbeeld Relatics, is een pluspunt.
  • Uitstekende schriftelijke en mondelinge communicatievaardigheden in Nederlands en Frans. Engels is een sterke troef.
  • Vaardigheid om effectief samen te werken met diverse internationale teams en belanghebbenden.
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe problemen op te lossen.
  • Vermogen om onder tijdsdruk de processen te blijven volgen, meerdere projecten tegelijk te kunnen beheren en deadlines te halen.
  • Een proactieve houding om GIS binnen BESIX en diens projecten verder op de kaart te zetten.
  • Het vermogen om anderen te motiveren, op te leiden en te begeleiden.
  • Je ziet kansen om met innovaties het werk van anderen efficiënter en beter te maken.
  • Aanpassingsvermogen aan veranderende projectvereisten, omgevingen en stakeholders.

Een carrière bij BESIX is veel meer dan enkel een job. Bij ons denk je mee in een veranderende, innovatieve wereld.

Jouw vaardigheden, ambitie en passie zullen bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze groep en zullen ons in staat stellen om de uitdagingen van de komende jaren aan te gaan. Deel uitmaken van BESIX-groep is deel uitmaken van een zeer dynamisch, creatief en ondernemend bedrijf.

BESIX zorgt voor een veilige en collaboratieve werkomgeving, we hebben ambitieuze en innovatieve doelen voor de wereld van morgen, hierbij zijn jouw carrière en persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk voor ons.

We zijn op zoek naar mensen met verschillende persoonlijkheden, denkwijzen en met verschillende achtergronden. We zoeken mensen met innovatieve ideeën die meehelpen met het bouwen aan de iconische en duurzame projecten van morgen!

In lijn met één van onze strategische gedragingen “Be Inclusive”, is BESIX bereid om tegemoet te komen aan elke redelijke aanpassing (niet-proportionele last), materieel of immaterieel, die de beperkende invloed van een ongepaste omgeving op de deelname van een persoon met een handicap zou neutraliseren. Praat er over met je recruiter als je solliciteert.

Ben je klaar om het verschil te maken en een positieve impact achter te laten voor de komende jaren? Wil je meehelpen met het behalen van onze bedrijfsdoelstelling: “We gaan de meest gedurfde uitdagingen van vandaag aan om blijvend nalatenschap te bouwen”? Kom dan bij de BESIX-familie, samen zullen we onze toekomst co-creëren.

Werken bij BESIX biedt vele voordelen, waaronder:

  • Een aantrekkelijk verloningspakket met een marktconform salaris, flexibele mobiliteitsvoordelen, telewerken, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekeringen, maaltijdcheques, werk-privébalansprogramma (zoals telewerken, zorg voor zieke kinderen, flexibel werkschema, telewerken, gezondheidsmanagement (sport, gezondheidscontroleprogramma, ...);

  • Een loopbaanverbeteringsprogramma dat niet alleen dient om ervoor te zorgen dat je constant leert en verbetert, maar ook dat je de mogelijkheid geeft om je carrièrehorizon uit te breiden;

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving met innovatieve collega's die uw inspanningen ondersteunen (ideeën, projecten, doelen, ambities);

  • Mogelijkheid om aan complexe projecten te werken, zowel op lokaal niveau als in een internationale omgeving;

  • Blijf lokaal verankerd voor de komende jaren of durf voor een internationale carrièremogelijkheid binnen de groep te gaan.

title: Director of Credit Risk and Portfolio Analytics
description:
At First Electronic Bank (FEB or Bank), we are driven by the purpose to make credit accessible to everyday Americans and their businesses. Partnering with some of the most innovative fintech companies in the nation, we offer a wide range of consumer and commercial credit and deposit products on a national basis. Offering deposit accounts and debit cards, revolving lines of credit, private-label credit cards, installment financing programs and more, FEB engages with strategic, collaborative partners, promoting services and products to provide the most beneficial consumer and commercial financing solutions.


The Director of Credit Risk and Portfolio Analytics will lead a team responsible for assessing, managing, and mitigating the credit risk associated with our loan portfolio. This hands-on leadership role will be focused on developing our loan retention program and the subsequent creation and monitoring of our loan portfolio. You will be using quantitative methods to identify credit risk, develop and recommend credit strategies, and monitor credit performance for consumer credit portfolios to optimize profitable growth within the risk appetite of the Bank.


This role will work closely with various departments, including Finance, Operations, and Compliance, to ensure that our loan portfolios are meeting the required economic hurdles and remain in compliance with industry and regulatory standards. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining credit risk tools/models, conducting credit risk assessments, monitoring credit risk exposures, developing and maintaining economic models, and providing reporting and recommendations to senior management.


What You'll Do:

  • Develop, and conduct regular in-depth analysis to monitor the performance of consumer credit portfolios at the Bank to identify risk drivers for both growth and risk mitigation
  • Lead the creation of metrics and dashboards to proactively quantify and monitor credit risk and portfolio performance that are presented to committee on regular basis
  • Make recommendations to adjust portfolio mix to mitigate observed risk to meet/maintain initial investment objectives
  • Develop and manage vintage based curves (static pools) for payments and losses, for a variety of our loan portfolio assets
  • Develop and maintain accurate forecasting and planning models that enable the business to predict unit-based and portfolio-based economic outcomes for base line and simulated (stressed) scenarios
  • Lead the credit loss forecasting and modeling functions and work closely with Finance and support the CECL reserve processes
  • Manage a team of 1 to 3 support analysts and coach staff to achieve high levels of performance and meaningful career growth
  • Participate in internal and external audits related to credit risk, including FDIC and UDFI exam management, in particular for Safety and Soundness exam related items (CAMELS).
  • Drive the agenda for the evolution of the Bank’s risk data infrastructure.

title: Talent Recruitment & Retention Coordinator
description:
Mission: We believe in creating the best life for everyone!

To attract, recruit, and help retain exceptional employees who align with Believe Therapies' mission, culture, and standards by developing strong talent pipelines, building relationships with universities with Speech, Physical, and Occupational therapy programs, strengthening employee engagement and retention, and authentically showcasing the people, culture, and client successes that demonstrate what it means to work at Believe Therapies.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Establish and maintain relationships with colleges and universities that educate OT, PT, Speech, OTA, PTA, and SLPA candidates.

• Develop relationships with program directors, faculty, clinical education coordinators, career services departments, and student organizations as appropriate.

• Maintain an organized database of university contacts, programs, recruiting opportunities, career fairs, graduation cycles, and follow-up activities.

• Develop and maintain an annual university recruitment calendar based on graduation dates, career fairs, student events, and anticipated Believe Therapies staffing needs.

• Represent Believe Therapies at appropriate university career fairs, recruiting events, presentations, and other talent-development opportunities.

• Work with clinical leadership to identify appropriate opportunities to introduce students and new graduates to Believe Therapies.

• Develop long-term talent pipelines so university relationships result in qualified applicants and hires rather than functioning solely as outreach activities.

• Track the effectiveness of university relationships and recruiting activities.

• Develop long-term talent pipelines by introducing high school students to careers in Speech-Language Pathology (ST), Occupational Therapy (OT), and Physical Therapy (PT) before college by establishing relationships with local high schools and attending relevant career-related events.


Employee Retention & Engagement

• Work under the direction of the HR Administrator to monitor employee retention and identify trends that may affect turnover.

• Track retention and turnover data and assist in identifying patterns by position, discipline, location, tenure, or other relevant factors.

• Participate in appropriate employee check-ins, stay interviews, onboarding follow-up, and other retention activities as directed by the HR Administrator.

• Gather employee feedback and communicate meaningful themes or concerns to the HR Administrator without assuming responsibility for matters requiring HR investigation or management action.

• Assist in developing initiatives that strengthen employee connection, recognition, professional growth, and engagement.

• Coordinate appropriate recognition of employee accomplishments, anniversaries, professional achievements, promotions, certifications, and other milestones.

• Monitor early turnover and work with the HR Administrator and appropriate leaders to identify opportunities to improve retention.


Culture, Staff & Client Success Content

• Continually ask and actively seek the answer to: “What is happening at Believe Therapies that shows a great therapist why they would want to work here?” Use the answer to identify authentic recruiting, retention, and culture stories.

• Proactively identify and capture stories that demonstrate the culture, people, and impact of Believe Therapies.

• Showcase employee accomplishments, professional growth, certifications, anniversaries, promotions, team activities, and other meaningful staff achievements.

• Coordinate with clinical teams to identify and celebrate client milestones and successful graduations from therapy as examples of both client success and the work of Believe Therapies' therapists.

• Develop a consistent pipeline of authentic photos, short-form videos, employee spotlights, client success stories, recruiting content, and other material appropriate for Believe Therapies' social media and digital platforms.

• Interview or work with employees to develop content that communicates what it is like to work at Believe Therapies and why employees choose to build their careers with the organization.

• Capture appropriate content during clinic activities, recruiting events, university visits, celebrations, and other opportunities that reflect Believe Therapies' culture.

• Prepare and organize content for social media use, including photos, videos, story concepts, captions, or supporting information, while coordinating with the individual responsible for publishing and managing Believe Therapies' social media accounts.

• Maintain an organized content calendar or content bank so recruiting and culture-related material is consistently available rather than created only when needed.

• Ensure all client-related content has appropriate authorization and follows Believe Therapies' privacy, HIPAA, consent, and company requirements before it is submitted for publication.

• Ensure content accurately and authentically represents the employee and client experience at Believe Therapies and supports the company's recruiting and retention objectives.


HR Support

• Work closely with the HR Administrator throughout recruiting, hiring, onboarding, retention, and employee-engagement activities.

• Ensure recruiting and candidate activities comply with established company policies and HR procedures.

• Maintain appropriate confidentiality of applicant and employee information.

• Assist with onboarding coordination and help ensure a smooth transition from candidate to new employee.

• Provide recruiting and retention information needed for HR planning and staffing decisions.

• Escalate employee-relations, performance, policy, compensation, compliance, or other HR matters outside the authority of the position to the HR Administrator.

• Perform other duties consistent with the position and Believe Therapies' mission as requested.


SKILLS NEEDED

Must be outgoing, professional, organized, highly relationship-oriented, and comfortable initiating relationships rather than waiting for candidates to come to Believe Therapies. Must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication, strong follow-through, attention to detail, effective time management, creativity, and confidence communicating with professionals at all levels. Must be comfortable capturing photos and short-form video and developing authentic story ideas for recruiting and culture content. Must be able to manage multiple candidates and activities simultaneously, work by statistics, recognize declining production, and take appropriate action or communicate the need for support.

title: Remote Senior Backend Engineer, Integrations
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do

You'll be joining the Platform Integration Team (PIT Crew) — a high-impact group whose mandate is critical to the scalability and extensibility of the NodeZero platform. The PIT Crew's mission is to transform Horizon3's APIs and integrations from a collection of one-off vendor connectors into a consistent, documented, permission-aware platform. You'll build the systems that let customers connect NodeZero to the tools they already rely on across the security and IT ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll lead through technical judgment, cross-functional partnership, and high-quality execution — owning significant pieces of platform infrastructure while helping set the standard for the team.

In this role, you will:

  • API Platform: evolving our internal GraphQL-federated API into a first-class, customer-facing product — with permissions, multi-account scoping, versioning, schema evolution, and documentation.

  • Integration Platform: building and operating a shared Integration Router so new connectors can be configured and declared rather than built from scratch, with reusable authentication, health checks, and workflow execution.

  • Security-Tool Integrations: shipping and maintaining integrations with the tools customers already use — CrowdStrike, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, Palo Alto, SentinelOne, and others in the SIEM, EDR, and ticketing ecosystem.

  • MCP Platform: expanding our customer-facing MCP server and agentic workflow capabilities across US, EU, and Australia production environments, enabling customers to build their own AI-powered workflows atop NodeZero data.

  • You'll also share on-call responsibility for a substantial production-observability footprint (Datadog, Kafka-triggered services, multiple environments), meaning you're not just shipping integrations — you're operating them.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Design and implement backend APIs in GraphQL — including federated subgraph development, schema evolution, and multi-account query scoping for MSSP and multi-subsidiary customers.

  • Build and extend the Integration Router: connector libraries, workflow configuration, secrets management, vendor adapters, and Kafka-triggered dispatch services.

  • Own production reliability for API and integration services: monitoring, alerting, deployment, vendor API drift, rate limits, retries, and safe failure handling.

  • Contribute to the MCP platform and OAuth proxy layer, including tool authentication and agentic workflow support.

  • Contribute production code that sets the standard for design quality, code quality, and operational rigor.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and security-domain teams (particularly the Pentest Data Platform) to deliver integrated customer experiences.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on the team as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • Ability to own and manage concurrent initiatives, with strong judgment in prioritization and time management.

  • Self-directed and driven — capable of conceiving and implementing solutions independently and as part of a team.

  • A strong desire to continuously learn new technologies in a fast-paced Agile environment.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a high bar for quality.

  • Strong technical documentation ability to support an external developer audience.

  • Effective communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

  • Interest in mentoring junior and mid-level engineers as the team grows.

Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience using modern object-oriented or functional languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, Scala, C++, etc.).

  • Experience building production applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

What Sets You Apart

  • Expert proficiency in SQL, and experience with relational (PostgreSQL) and graph (Neo4j) database architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building GraphQL backends, including federated graph architectures and schema evolution patterns.

  • Experience designing and operating public API platforms — versioning, developer documentation, permission models, and multi-tenant access.

  • Experience building or operating an integrations platform with reusable connector patterns, event-driven workflows (Kafka or similar), and asynchronous execution.

  • Familiarity with OAuth/OIDC, service accounts, or machine identity patterns for programmatic API access.

  • Experience integrating with third-party security or IT platforms — SIEMs, EDR tools, ticketing systems (e.G., CrowdStrike, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, Palo Alto), or workflow automation platforms.

  • Experience with MCP, agentic frameworks, or other tool-protocol ecosystems.

  • Production reliability experience: observability tooling (Datadog or similar), on-call ownership, vendor API drift handling, and safe failure design.

  • Experience with customer-facing developer surfaces: CLI tooling, SDKs, or developer portals.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $170,000 - $235,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Full-Time Limited Term Branded Content Producer
description:
KQED is building a branded and sponsored content business around some of its most valuable digital properties, including Snap Judgment, Spooked, and a growing slate of social, video, audio, and multiplatform formats. The Branded Content Producer will lead the creative development and execution of sold campaigns while helping establish the workflows, production infrastructure, and partner network needed to grow this emerging business responsibly.

We are looking for a versatile, entrepreneurial producer who can work across the full lifecycle of branded content, from concept development through final delivery. As the first dedicated production hire for this business, this person will operate across multiple functions and build the operational foundation that future hires will support. The Branded Content Producer will sit within the digital video team and work in close partnership with KQED’s Sponsorship team.

This is a Full-Time Limited Term Role for 3 years.

Salary Range: $92.068- $115085 Annually

QED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling.

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media. We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.




Essential Functions

Creative Development and Pre-Sale
  • Translate client objectives and KQED audience insights into platform-appropriate concepts, treatments, scripts, scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, and production budgets across video, social, audio, digital, and experiential formats.
  • Turn around initial creative concepts within 48 hours of receiving an RFP, using a standard template that the Sponsorship team can present to prospective clients.
  • Participate in pre-sale conversations as needed to present creative concepts, explain production approaches, and answer client questions.
  • Assess the creative, operational, and financial feasibility of opportunities before they are sold, identifying assumptions, constraints, rights requirements, production capacity, and costs to reflect in the client agreement.
Project and Client Management
  • Serve as the primary production contact for clients after a project is sold, leading kickoffs, setting expectations, presenting creative work, managing feedback and approvals, and addressing changes in scope, schedule, or budget.
  • Own multiple projects simultaneously from kickoff through closeout, balancing client commitments, editorial standards, production capacity, budgets, and delivery deadlines.
  • Maintain a clear view of active and prospective projects, schedules, budgets, deliverables, dependencies, and resource needs, and communicate risks to leadership and Sponsorship partners.
  • Coordinate with Sponsorship, Legal, Business Affairs, Editorial, Marketing, Audience Development, Finance, Production Operations, and other internal stakeholders to secure required input and approvals.
Production
  • Develop and manage pre-production plans, schedules, scopes of work, production budgets, staffing plans, and client expectations for sold projects.
  • Hire and manage freelance crews, production companies, talent, and other vendors based on the creative and operational needs of each project.
  • Identify opportunities to use KQED facilities, equipment, and approved internal production capacity, and secure external resources when needed.
  • During production in the field, studio, or other settings, maintain KQED’s production quality, editorial standards, and agreed-upon client deliverables.
  • Manage project budgets throughout production, identifying and documenting changes to scope, schedule, or cost and reconciling expenses at project closeout.
Post-Production and Delivery
  • Oversee post-production from paper edit through final delivery, managing editorial review, client feedback, revisions, version control, accessibility, quality control, and final approval.
  • Assign and supervise freelance editors and approved internal staff within the production budget established for each project.
  • Ensure proper media management, documentation, and asset handling throughout production and post-production.
  • Deliver final assets according to client requirements, platform specifications, accessibility standards, and KQED’s archival practices.
Editorial Standards, Rights, and Compliance
  • Ensure projects comply with KQED’s editorial and brand standards, sponsor-category restrictions, platform requirements, applicable union agreements, and FTC and other disclosure requirements.
  • Maintain a clear separation between sponsor influence and KQED’s independent editorial decision-making, escalating potential editorial conflicts or brand-safety concerns to the appropriate leader.
  • Coordinate releases, licenses, rights clearances, music permissions, insurance documentation, accessibility requirements, and other production documentation in partnership with Legal and Business Affairs.
Business Operations and Infrastructure
  • Establish repeatable workflows, templates, production schedules, approval processes, and documentation covering the full branded-content lifecycle, from initial RFP through project closeout.
  • Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements that increase production quality, consistency, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Build and maintain a vetted, diverse roster of production companies, freelancers, and vendors that can be deployed based on project needs, format, location, and budget.
  • Partner with Audience Development and analytics teams to establish campaign tracking requirements and assess performance against agreed-upon deliverables and objectives.

Other Job Functions
  • Document project learnings and contribute to post-project reporting, case studies, sales materials, and internal best practices.
  • Represent the branded-content production function in relevant internal planning meetings and external partner conversations.
  • Support special projects and emerging sponsored-content opportunities as business needs and production capacity allow.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • 5+ years producing branded, sponsored, or commercial content for digital platforms, ideally within a media company, branded content studio, or production company
  • Demonstrated ability to develop concepts quickly and communicate them clearly in decks and client conversations
  • Full-lifecycle production experience: budgeting, scheduling, crewing, on-set leadership, and post supervision
  • Experience managing client relationships during production, including setting expectations and navigating feedback
  • Working knowledge of post workflows and media management best practices
  • An existing network of freelancers and production vendors, or the ability to build one quickly
  • Experience creating scopes of work, production estimates, and change orders, with a demonstrated ability to manage scope, budget, and client expectations
  • Strong project-management skills and experience managing multiple productions with overlapping deadlines
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to recognize and escalate brand-safety, disclosure, rights, or sponsor-influence concerns
  • Experience working with legal agreements, talent and location releases, licensing, insurance requirements, and production rights clearances
  • Experience producing across multiple digital formats and adapting creative for different platforms and audience behaviors
  • Excellent written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Comfort operating solo in a new function where processes are still being defined

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience at a public media organization or mission-driven brand
  • Familiarity with FTC disclosure standards for sponsored and branded content
  • Short-form social video production experience (Reels, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working alongside unionized production environments
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

title: Construction Superintendent - New Construction
description:
About the Position

DevCo US Construction is hiring for a Full-Time Construction Superintendent to join our multi-family development project in Phoenix, AZ (District at Laveen)! District at Laveen is a 250-unit ground-up construction (three-story) garden-style build with ten buildings, and a clubhouse. The Site Superintendent is responsible for ensuring that projects are delivered on time, on budget, meeting quality standards and are done safely. The Site Superintendent is responsible for overseeing all of the daily operations of the construction site.

About the Company

DevCo Residential is a family of companies including DevCo US Construction, DevCo Preservation and HNN Communities. DevCo Residential is a privately held real estate investment company with almost 40 years of experience. Founded in 1994, the company and its affiliates develop, own, and manage over 14,000 affordable and market rate apartment units throughout the United States. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, DevCo is one of the largest providers of affordable housing in Washington State. Together, we professionally develop, build and own multi-family affordable apartment communities. We understand the importance of affordable housing and make it our mission to keep quality our top priority.

Mission:

DevCo Residential Group’s mission is to develop, construct and manage high-quality multifamily housing that provides stability, fosters growth and delivers long-term value to our residents and stakeholders.

Vision:

DevCo’s vision is to be a leading developer, builder and manager of quality multifamily housing throughout the western US.

Values:

Work with the Project Manager to prepare status reports and regularly monitor deliveries, subcontractors and schedules. Oversee and direct the allocation of project resources appropriately (manpower, materials and equipment) through phone conversations and emails keeping accurate records of daily activities.

  • Supervise entire construction field staff, ensuring project deadlines are met
  • Ability to anticipate and overcome project challenges
  • Maintain a strong relationship with Project Managers
  • Lead daily/weekly meetings to ensure the team is working together successfully and delivering quality work

  • The ability to become proficient in Procore, Bluebeam, and MS Project (proficiency greatly preferred).

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ground Up Low Income Housing Tax Credit Multifamily Construction Project Experience
  • Garden Style, Podium, Wrap and/or Open Courtyard and Urban Mid Rise Project Experience. Post Tension experience desirable.
  • Strong Reputation for working well with Subcontractors
  • Ability to create strong relationships with stakeholders
  • Manage entire process from start to finish - including site clearing, earth work, underground utilities, site planning/logistics, managing/leading the entire field team on the site, walking the site regularly, scheduling, evaluating performance, & communicating to Project Manager.

title: Director, Consumer Growth - AI-Native (ATX Preffered)
description:
Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights—seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country. Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.

We are looking for a Director, Consumer Growth (AI-Native) to own paid and organic acquisition for the Consumer business and build the agent infrastructure that runs it. This is a hands-on role: you will set strategy across paid social, paid search, SEO, and organic, then build and operate the AI agents that execute media buying, creative iteration, and reporting with limited day-to-day human direction. You are the person who decides what the agents do, builds the systems that let them do it, and steps in when they can't.

You will turn growth opportunities into sharp commercial hypotheses, test them fast, and decide what deserves investment and scale, grounded in customer needs and unit economics. Secondarily, you will extend this same approach into new revenue vectors for the business: fast prototypes, landing pages, and fake-door tests that validate commercialization ideas before we commit real investment.

What you'll do:

Build and operate the AI agent infrastructure for growth

  • Design and build the agent orchestration layer that runs paid media with limited human direction, using tools such as Grokbot, Ryze, Claude, and platform-native AI (Advantage+, Performance Max, automated bidding).

  • Build an AI-assisted creative engine that generates, tests, and iterates ad concepts at high volume, within healthcare advertising policies and compliance standards.

  • Define what agents own outright, what needs human review, and how failures get caught, and stay close enough to the work to prototype and troubleshoot it yourself.

    • Own and scale paid and organic acquisition

    • Own paid acquisition across paid social (Meta, TikTok, and emerging platforms) and paid search (Google, Bing): strategy, budget, bidding, audiences, and day-to-day optimization.

    • Own organic acquisition, including AEO/GEO, SEO, and content, leveraging the AI architecture above.

    • Manage a media budget of $5M+ annually against CAC, ROAS, and payback targets, reallocating spend weekly based on performance.

    • Lead measurement in a privacy-constrained environment: incrementality testing, attribution, MMM-informed planning, and HIPAA-aware tracking.

    • Manage agency and freelance partners, holding them to clear performance standards.

      • Prototype new revenue vectors

      • As a secondary focus, identify new revenue vectors for the business and validate them fast with landing pages, fake-door tests, and quick prototypes before committing real investment.

      • Run a repeatable system for moving from insight to prototype to experiment to scale decision on new commercialization ideas.

        • Build and manage the team

        • Lead and develop a small, high-output pod, managing a blended team of AI agents and contractors and matching each task to the right mix of the two, partnering closely across product, engineering, marketing, analytics, and compliance.

What success looks like:

In the first 90 days

  • Audit paid, organic, and tracking; deliver early efficiency gains.

  • Stand up the first agent-run workflows for campaigns or creative, with clear human checkpoints.

  • Establish the pod's operating model and a prioritized experiment backlog.

    • In the first 12 to 18 months

    • Improve blended CAC and payback while scaling spend across paid and organic.

    • Manage AI agent-powered campaigns and creative workflow that operates at scale with minimal headcount.

    • Demonstrate commercial proof through at least one validated new revenue vector, with a credible path to scale.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years managing paid social and paid search directly in-platform.

  • A track record managing multi-million-dollar media budgets against CAC and payback targets.

  • Hands-on experience building or orchestrating AI agents or automation for campaign management, creative production, or performance analysis, with examples you can walk us through.

  • Experience owning organic channels (SEO, content, or organic social) alongside paid.

  • Strong command of growth economics and measurement, including incrementality testing and post-iOS attribution.

  • Experience leading small, capable teams and managing agencies.

  • BA/BS or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience advertising in healthcare, telehealth, pharma, or another regulated category.

  • Experience with DTC subscription or repeat-purchase businesses.

  • Experience launching 0-to-1 products, landing pages, or fake-door tests to validate new revenue ideas.

You may be especially well suited in this role if you are:

  • A growth leader who has owned a media budget end to end and wants to run it through AI agents instead of a traditional team.

  • Someone who has built or deployed AI agents for real operational work, not just experimented with them.

  • Equally comfortable inside an ad account, a prompt or agent config, and an executive strategy discussion.

Security Notice: Everlywell never requests fees, payment, or banking information at any stage of the recruitment process. Official communications and interview invitations will only come from verified email addresses ending in @everlywell.com or @everlyhealth.com. To ensure your application is secure, always apply directly through our official careers page at .

title: 1st Shift Maintenance Lead
description:
Position Title:

title: GIS Specialist
description:
As a GIS Specialist at BESIX, you will play a crucial role in managing, analyzing, and visualizing spatial data to support construction projects in Belgium and France (remote). You will work closely with various teams, including engineers, planners, project managers, and designers, to efficiently leverage geographic information in operational and decision-making processes.

You will join the Information Management team, reporting to the BIM/GIS Manager. In addition, you will collaborate closely with GIS and BIM colleagues across BESIX Belgium and Nederland.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

  • Develop and manage GIS maps, datasets, and applications for ongoing and future projects in Belgium and internationally.
  • Analyze and visualize geographic information to provide insights into project areas.
  • Integrate GIS data with BIM models and other technical systems.
  • Automate spatial analyses and data processing using Python, FME, or other GIS tools.
  • Collaborate with teams in the Netherlands and Belgium to optimize best practices and data
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geoinformatics or another relevant field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role.

  • Proven hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro.
  • Proven experience with Python and FME.
  • Experience with ArcGIS Online and/or ArcGIS Enterprise.
  • Experience working with (Enterprise) Geodatabases.
  • Experience with BIM-related data is considered a plus.
  • Experience with drone data is considered a plus.
  • Experience using GIS in relation to other information systems, such as Relatics, is considered a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch and French; English is a strong asset.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex problems.
  • Ability to maintain processes under pressure, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
  • A proactive mindset to further promote and expand the use of GIS within BESIX and its projects.
  • Ability to motivate, train, and guide others.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where innovation can improve efficiency and enhance the work of others.
  • Aanpassingsvermogen aan veranderende projectvereisten, omgevingen en stakeholders.
  • Adaptability to changing project requirements, environments, and stakeholder needs.

A career at BESIX is a lot more than just a job, it's about being part of our changing and innovative world. Your skills, ambition and passion will contribute to the development of our different businesses and allow us to succeed in the challenges of the coming years.

Working for the BESIX group allows you to be a part of a dynamic, creative and entrepreneurial company. It gives you a safe and collaborative working environment with ambitious and innovative goals for the world of tomorrow, but also for your career and personal development.

We are looking for different kinds of personalities, mindsets, backgrounds and genders to build the iconic and sustainable projects of tomorrow.

In line with its behavior of “Be Inclusive”, BESIX intends to accommodate for any reasonable accommodation (non-disproportionate burden), tangible or intangible, that would neutralize the limiting influence of an inappropriate environment on the participation of a person with a disability. Talk to your recruiter when applying.

Are you ready to make an impact and leave a positive legacy for years to come? If you are passionate about our purpose: “We take on today’s boldest challenges to build a lasting legacy”, come and join our caring BESIX family. Together we will co-create our future.

Working at BESIX brings a lot of great benefits including:

title: Field Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
Field Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

US-Remote

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Who We Are

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions provider that partners with organizations to solve meaningful challenges and drive sustainable growth. From early-stage startups to global enterprises, we work across industries to optimize our clients’ digital products through product strategy innovation, experiential design, AI solutions, and deep engineering expertise.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energizes you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You’ve spent 10+ years in custom software consultancies, and you’ve been a regular presence on both sides of the business: in the room helping win the work, and in delivery helping build it. You know how to pitch a client honestly and then stand behind what you promised.

You’re highly articulate and commercially fluent. You can talk architecture with a skeptical engineering lead in one meeting and talk ROI with a client’s CEO in the next, and both walk away trusting you. You understand how technical choices shape whether a project makes money because you’ve had to make those calls yourself.

Your technical judgment comes from years of hands-on work, and you keep it current in two ways: you read widely, and you keep doing the work. “Doing” might be a few hours each week staying sharp with new tools, or it might be real delivery responsibility on a live engagement. Either way, you don’t run on knowledge that stopped accruing years ago.

You’re comfortable leading by influence rather than authority. You may not be our deepest expert on any single topic, and that’s fine, because your value shows up differently:

  • You ask experienced technologists the kind of sharp questions that send them back to their desk thinking.
  • You know a good deal across a wide range of subjects and connect ideas others keep separate.
  • You’re an excellent communicator, in writing and on your feet.
  • You bring out people’s best work through interpersonal connection and high standards.

Your name carries some weight in the communities you’re part of. When you write or speak, senior engineers pay attention, and a few of them want to come work with you.

This is primarily a market-facing role. You’d rather be out in the market shaping where we go than waiting inside for an assignment.

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

We win work by earning technical trust before a contract is ever signed, and by being genuinely present in the market the rest of the time. This role carries both. You’ll report to the CEO and work most closely with the CEO, the VP of Growth, our practice Partners, and senior technologists.

Your primary focus will require you to:

  • Join deal teams to help win new engagements. In a pitch that can mean proposing an architecture, shaping scope, sequencing the work into sensible stages, or recommending how to staff it. On our most important accounts, you’ll stay a technical presence the client trusts well after the work begins.
  • Represent us and build relationships in the market. Give talks, write, and show up in person at events. In-person presence matters here, and writing alone won’t carry the role.
  • Shape and sharpen what we sell. Turn what you’re seeing in the market into clearer, more current offerings, and keep our position honest: agentic products, deep platform expertise.
  • Work with our Growth team to help identify and build relationships with platform and AI partners that put us in front of the right work and keep our teams current.
  • Drive our go-to-market direction rather than wait for it. Bring a point of view and help us continuously iterate on where we should show up, what we should say, and which opportunities are worth chasing.

Internally, your footprint is lighter but real. You’re the standard other technologists measure themselves against, and you’re a mentor to those working on their business leadership and impact. You’ll weigh in from time to time on technical job standards and career pathing. You’ll start without direct reports and lead through influence, and as we grow, the role could grow into leading a small team.

Strongly Preferred Skills

We’d particularly like to hear from applicants with:

  • A track record of pitching and winning enterprise engagements inside a consultancy
  • A public technical presence: talks you’ve given, things you’ve written, communities you help lead
  • Experience shaping the service offerings or the technical point of view a firm takes to market
  • Relationships with cloud or AI platform partners, and the standing that comes with them
  • A working grasp of where AI and agentic tooling is heading, enough to judge where the real opportunities are
  • Experience mentoring senior technical talent and raising the bar around them

Compensation

Our pay range for the Field CTO role is $230,000–$287,500 USD, plus 20–30% variable compensation based on performance.

Travel Expectation

This role involves regular but not frequent travel, mostly for in-person events, client pitches, and the occasional team gatherings.

How You’ll Be Supported

At 8th Light, our culture is built on the belief that our collective growth and well-being are the drivers of our future.

  • Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
  • A robust L&D program featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
  • Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
  • Coworking support for our global team
  • Flexible PTO with floating company holidays
  • 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

8th Light’s culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

If you are hired into a hub, you will be part of a team with regular rituals around co-working and community building. For team members outside of those cities, we offer access to coworking spaces to foster continued collaboration and connection across our global team.

We hope to see you apply!

#LI-Remote

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

title: Commercial & IP Legal Lead | Head Office
description:
Hi!

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

Our Legal Team is looking for a Commercial & IP Lead — a lawyer who gets genuinely irritated when a contract takes a week to get signed.

Most lawyers read contracts. You will redesign how contracts happen. Our ambition is simple to say and hard to do: a typical agreement signed within about an hour, with the overwhelming majority of the flow running automatically — templates, playbooks, CLM, e-signature, AI — and lawyers touching only the deals that truly deserve a lawyer. You'll lead the Commercial & IP pillar of the legal department, own the contract lifecycle end-to-end across dozens of business teams, and turn "waiting for legal" from an office meme into ancient history.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead the Commercial & IP pillar of the legal department and manage its team.
  • Own the full contract lifecycle for the group: intake, triage, drafting, negotiation, execution, storage.
  • Standardize the contract base: templates, playbooks, and self-service routes for low-risk agreements.
  • Drive contract-process automation as a flagship project — target state: a typical contract signed within about an hour, with the large majority of volume routed fully automatically and only the most significant agreements handled manually.
  • Define and hold SLAs for contract turnaround; report throughput and bottlenecks.
  • Manage IP portfolio matters: trademarks, domains, licensing and assignment chains.
  • Coordinate handoffs with the Regulatory & Compliance and Corporate & Transactions pillars; escalate material risks to the Head of Legal.
  • Act as the legal-side owner in cross-functional automation work with the AI/development team.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU:

  • Strong contract drafting and negotiation in English: B2B service, SaaS/subscription, marketing and affiliate, vendor/procurement, licensing, and IP-related agreements.
  • Ability to design and maintain contract templates, clause libraries, and negotiation playbooks (standard positions + fallbacks + escalation triggers).
  • Contract process design end-to-end: intake → triage → drafting → approval → signature → storage, with clear SLAs and delegation rules (what needs a lawyer vs. what runs on self-service).
  • Hands-on experience with CLM and e-signature tools (selection, implementation, or administration) and ticket-based intake (e.g., Jira).
  • Practical use of AI tools for contract review and drafting; ability to define requirements for automating legal workflows together with a development team.
  • Working knowledge of IP in commercial context: assignments, licensing, trademarks, domains.
  • Understanding of data-protection touchpoints in commercial contracts (DPAs, cross-border transfer mechanics) sufficient to coordinate with the compliance team.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:

  • Step 1: Pre-screen.
  • Step 2: Technical interview.
  • Step 3: Test task.
  • Step 4: Final interview.
  • Step 5: Reference check.
  • Step 6: Job Offer!

WHAT WE OFFER

  • 28 business days of paid time off.
  • Flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely.
  • Medical insurance and mental health care.
  • Compensation for courses, trainings.
  • English classes and speaking clubs.
  • Internal library, educational events.
  • Outstanding corporate parties, teambuildings.
