We are proud to celebrate diversity and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, national origin, or any other status protected by law.

title: Senior Program Manager, Logistics Control Tower & Analytics – Data Center Supply Chain
location: Redwood City, CA; San Diego, CA; Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Austin, TX
description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function

As a member of the Data Center Supply Chain team, the Senior Program Manager, Logistics Control Tower & Analytics will own supplier logistics readiness and run the dedicated Control Tower provider/team supporting domestic OFCI execution. The role maintains live portfolio data, daily operating reviews, exceptions and action closure, performance reporting and business requirements for logistics tools. The Control Tower coordinates their readiness and agreed handoff evidence. The shared Supply Chain Governance and Assurance function owns the common framework; IT owns technical delivery and service.

SB Energy is building a procurement team under a common role profile, bringing together complementary electrical, mechanical, commercial, and logistics strengths. Within this team, this role focuses on logistics control tower operations, including shipment and milestone visibility, data quality, exception management, and performance reporting. The manager may lead control tower activities for an individual project, manage logistics visibility and reporting across multiple projects, or lead a shared logistics analytics or process improvement assignment.

Assignments may evolve as projects advance, workloads shift, and business priorities change. The manager is expected to contribute beyond their primary area, including broader procurement, sourcing, supplier development, or planning assignments, based on relevant experience, equipment knowledge, readiness, workload, and appropriate specialist support. Each manager maintains clear ownership of assigned responsibilities, cross-trains colleagues, and provides structured handoffs and backup coverage.

Candidates must demonstrate depth in logistics control tower operations, data analysis, and exception management, together with the flexibility and willingness to build capability across the broader function. Candidates are not expected to be specialists in every electrical, mechanical, commercial, or logistics discipline.

Responsibilities

  • Portfolio and Supplier Readiness: Maintain one reconciled OFCI register linking projects, equipment, POs, OEM readiness, agreed handoffs, domestic shipments, storage, custody, costs and exceptions. Track shipping-data completeness, cargo-ready commitments, packaging/preservation evidence and open readiness actions with OEMs. Procurement retains manufacturing/commercial expediting; Engineering/Quality retains technical release. Preserve required/baseline, planned, forecast, committed and actual dates and the data date.
  • Daily Operating Reviews: Direct the dedicated Control Tower team’s daily readiness, exception and action-closure work. Make risks to Required on Site Dates visible, secure accountable owners and escalate recovery decisions. Transportation authorizes domestic dispatch; Storage/Site owns inventory and preservation controls; designated functions retain their approvals.
  • Decision and Delivery Tracking: Maintain operating decision, action, risk, dependency, and change logs. Track the implementation plan across staffing, providers, contracts, processes, data, and training. Escalate overdue decisions, unassigned work, and resource gaps with a recommendation and decision deadline.
  • Business Product Ownership: Define operating requirements, prioritize the backlog, and lead user acceptance testing and adoption for the OFCI Logistics Control Hub or approved equivalent. Start with available tools and practical controls; agree build, release, support, and service ownership with designated Analytics and IT teams.
  • Data and Reporting: Define logistics KPI logic, source lineage, data-quality checks, dashboards, and executive decision views with capability owners and Finance. Reconcile incomplete or conflicting records, assign corrections to source owners, and keep material uncertainty visible. Validate technical deliverables against business requirements.
  • Provider Performance: Own the dedicated Control Tower provider/team’s scope, staffing, coverage, service levels, data quality, operational reviews and corrective actions. Require OEM-readiness and end-to-end logistics experience, evidence access and export rights. Support transport and warehouse leads with common reporting; their respective providers retain contracted execution obligations.
  • Governance and Assurance Interface: Apply common process, documentation, control, and evidence standards set with the shared Supply Chain Governance and Assurance function. Supply authoritative OFCI records for its reviews, coordinate operational corrective actions, and escalate recurring control weaknesses without creating duplicate trackers.
  • Adoption and Improvement: Lead OFCI-specific user guidance, training, release communications, and workflow improvements. Coordinate changes to common standards with Governance and Assurance and obtain functional approval for release-criteria changes. Prioritize automation against data readiness, approved technical design, and funded capacity.

Qualifications/Requirements

title: Staff Software Engineer, Vehicle Configuration Platform
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.

You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams.

  • Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working.

  • Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed.

  • Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention.

  • Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions.

  • Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership.

  • Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams.

  • A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems.

  • Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update.

  • Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds.

  • Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process.

  • Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time.

  • The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems.

  • Rust experience.

  • Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes.

  • Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators.

  • Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

title: Construction Superintendent - New Construction
description:
About the Position

DevCo US Construction is hiring for a Full-Time Construction Superintendent to join our multi-family development project in Phoenix, AZ (District at Laveen)! District at Laveen is a 250-unit ground-up construction (three-story) garden-style build with ten buildings, and a clubhouse. The Site Superintendent is responsible for ensuring that projects are delivered on time, on budget, meeting quality standards and are done safely. The Site Superintendent is responsible for overseeing all of the daily operations of the construction site.

About the Company

DevCo Residential is a family of companies including DevCo US Construction, DevCo Preservation and HNN Communities. DevCo Residential is a privately held real estate investment company with almost 40 years of experience. Founded in 1994, the company and its affiliates develop, own, and manage over 14,000 affordable and market rate apartment units throughout the United States. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, DevCo is one of the largest providers of affordable housing in Washington State. Together, we professionally develop, build and own multi-family affordable apartment communities. We understand the importance of affordable housing and make it our mission to keep quality our top priority.

Mission:

DevCo Residential Group’s mission is to develop, construct and manage high-quality multifamily housing that provides stability, fosters growth and delivers long-term value to our residents and stakeholders.

Vision:

DevCo’s vision is to be a leading developer, builder and manager of quality multifamily housing throughout the western US.

Values:

  • Quality: We deliver excellence in every aspect of our work.
  • Commitment: We honor our promises with unwavering dedication.
  • Teamwork: We achieve more together through collaboration and respect.
  • Integrity: We uphold the highest ethical standards in all we do.

Pay Details: $130,000 to $160,000 in Annual Salary + Performance bonus target of 15%

Schedule: Generally, Monday-Friday at the construction site (as agreed upon with the hiring manager)

Benefits Offered

  • 100% company paid medical benefits for employee coverage, and immediate family members.
  • 100% company paid dental and vision benefits for employee coverage, and immediate family members.
  • Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts.
  • Company paid life insurance, AD&D and long-term disability benefits for employee coverage.
  • Best-in-class voluntary insurance benefits.
  • Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) programs with a company match equal to 100% of the first 4% contributed by the employee.
  • Discretionary bonus programs.
  • Eligibility for a 30% housing discount consideration.
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) with 24/7 counseling service
  • Company-sponsored industry training and certifications.
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year.
  • 6 fixed and 4 floating holidays (10 in total).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Responsible to plan and set up the job site, preparation and maintenance of Project Schedule and ensure the life/ safety plans are developed and implemented. Oversee the Assistant Superintendent for scheduling of materials, equipment, manpower, and subcontractors to ensure project schedule and quality are met. Review and approve the updated project schedule that the Assistant Site Superintendent will distribute to all subcontractors. Monitor the pace and quality of work. Work with the Project Manager to prepare status reports and regularly monitor deliveries, subcontractors and schedules. Oversee and direct the allocation of project resources appropriately (manpower, materials and equipment) through phone conversations and emails keeping accurate records of daily activities.

  • Supervise entire construction field staff, ensuring project deadlines are met
  • Ability to anticipate and overcome project challenges
  • Maintain a strong relationship with Project Managers
  • Lead daily/weekly meetings to ensure the team is working together successfully and delivering quality work
  • Manage and maintain project safety
  • Maintain OSHA requirements at all times
  • Participate in OAC meetings as required

  • Travel will be required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ground Up Low Income Housing Tax Credit Multifamily Construction Project Experience
  • Garden Style, Podium, Wrap and/or Open Courtyard and Urban Mid Rise Project Experience. Post Tension experience desirable.
  • Strong Reputation for working well with Subcontractors
  • Ability to create strong relationships with stakeholders
  • Manage entire process from start to finish - including site clearing, earth work, underground utilities, site planning/logistics, managing/leading the entire field team on the site, walking the site regularly, scheduling, evaluating performance, & communicating to Project Manager.

title: INSTRUCTOR
description:
About this Job


ANNOUNCEMENT NO. 176-2026 BENEFITS

OPENING DATE: October 02, 2026 Retirement: LASERS

CLOSING DATE: October 16, 2026 Insurance: Medical, Dental, & Vision

Paid Holidays:10 plus proclaimed

*SALARY: Annual Leave: 96 hours per year with tenure increases

ME-413 $40,914 - $49,109 Sick Leave:96 hours per year with tenure increase

*Salary indicates typical starting range.

Level will be determined by qualifications.


JOB TYPE: Unclassified*

*Current Classified employees must give up their designation to accept this position. Unclassified employees serve at the pleasure of their appointing authority.

Department Mission

Intervene in and reclaim the lives of 16-to-18-year-old at-risk youth, producing programgraduateswiththevalues,lifeskills,education,andself-disciplinenecessaryto succeed as productive Louisiana citizens.

WHO WE ARE:

YCP is a voluntary program that target youth who are at risk of not completing high school. We provide an environment for youth so they may focus on completing academic goals while enhancing personal strengths and resiliency. Our program provides a structured environment and teaches discipline, self-control and motivation. We develop the whole person by focusing on 8 core components that support each cadet’s personal development: academic excellence, life coping skills, job skills training, responsible citizenship, leader/followership, health & hygiene, physical fitness and service to community.


POSITION DESCRIPTION:

Provide educational experiences to remediate academic deficits and increase overall grade level of all cadets. Students will be instructed in life skills to obtain maximum independence and become productive citizens. Instructors are responsible for teaching the Pre-HiSET/HiSET/Life Skills curriculum to one Team of cadets per cycle. The Keyboarding Instructor will teach Keyboarding to all Teams. In addition, Lead Instructor may assign additional duties as needed which may not appear on any enumerated list. Both classroom expectations and YCP rules in the Cadet Handbook are enforced by Instructors. Disciplinary Reports are turned in to the Lead Instructor ASAP for review, input into computer, and forwarding to Cadre and Counselors. Instructors are responsible to ensure that assigned Teams are in authorized areas according to posted Academic Department schedules, unless otherwise approved or directed by Lead Instructor. Instructors teach Life Skills starting at Week 5 until Week 17. Curriculum is published and in the hands of each Instructor. Instructor will prepare a new Individual Lesson Plan for each cadet following each TABE. Further, Instructors must maintain proper oversight concerning work assigned to cadets. Instructors should regularly check (at least twice weekly) that assigned work is being successfully completed by cadets and new work should be assigned. Instructors should initial and date Individual Lesson Plans as to when all work is assigned and completed by cadets. Cadets not doing assigned work in a timely manner should be disciplined accordingly. Instructors are required to attend staff meetings as scheduled by Lead Instructor. This is to keep abreast on YCP activities in other departments and to discuss issues and strategies in the Academic Department. Instructors are responsible for maintaining records on each cadet. Instructors must maintain a Grade Book for each Team. Attendance, all Life Skills Test scores, weekly Lesson Plans, and seating charts should be maintained. Whenever possible, Instructors will please route requests, issues, and problems to Lead Instructor in lieu of Executive Level Personnel or other department heads. The Academic Department uses the Chain-of-Command whenever possible, and resolves problems and/or issues at the lowest possible levels. It is mandatory for Instructors to meet with families on Family Day/s to discuss classroom progress and behavior. Instructors mail Progress Reports to parents following each TABE. Attendance at Awards ceremonies and Graduation is mandatory. It is mandatory for Instructors to report to work on Sunday In-Processing Days and on Sunday HiSET Re-take for prior cycle's cadets. Perform other duties as assigned.


POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:
Instructor must possess at least BA or BS (4 year degree) from an accredited college or university, and must provide YCP with official college or university transcript of grades. Instructor must possess a valid Louisiana Teaching Certificate and must provide a copy of Teaching Certificate to YCP.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:
• Must have a valid Driver's License, Social Security Card and Birth Certificate.
• Must be available to report to duty during emergency or disaster situations for extended hours over an extended period of time. Other periodic travel may be required.
• Must meet physical requirements to perform functions of the position.
• Must attend/complete all Louisiana Military Department (LMD) annual training and other training required for the position.
• Must adhere to the Code of Ethics and foster a Sexual Harassment-Free Environment.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT: By submitting an application for employment with the Military Department, the applicant agrees to the following conditions of employment:
• All LMD positions require in-office attendance. This is not a remote position.
• Salary is paid by Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) / Direct Deposit Only. A checking or savings account is required for employment.
• For positions requiring computer/email access selected applicant must qualify to obtain a Department of Defense Common Access Card (CAC) Card and maintain eligibility.
• LMD is a substance abuse and drug free workplace. The selected applicant must pass a pre-employment background investigation and pre-employment drug test. Thereafter, all employees are subject to random drug testing.
• To become an employee of the LMD you must be a current member of the Louisiana National Guard or eligible for membership in the Louisiana State Guard.
• The selected applicant must pass a pre-employment criminal background investigation prior to employment.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES: All Applicants must complete a LANG-LMD-H Form 10 (State Application) and attach a legible copy of their Official Birth Certificate, Driver's License and Social Security Card. Resumes are optional and will not be accepted unless they are submitted with the LANG-LMD-H Form 10 (State Application).

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Sr. Project Manager ( Redwood City, CA)

*** We do not sponsor employment/work visas at this time, if you need sponsorship now or in the future, unfortunately, your application will not be considered ***

Summary:

The Senior Project Manager leads business and technology projects from planning through implementation, stabilization, and transition to ongoing support. As the primary point of contact for project delivery, this role partners with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, and organizational leaders to define requirements, manage scope, support solution design, coordinate testing, and deliver successful outcomes. Based on project needs, the Senior Project Manager may also develop business requirements and leverage artificial intelligence agents and tools to enhance analysis and collaboration, expand requirements, and reduce project risk. This role follows Provident’s Project Management Methodology and applies supporting toolsets and KPI definition expertise to promote consistent project delivery and effective success-metric management.

Why Provident?

Provident Credit Union was established in 1950, and we rank among the top 10% of credit unions in the US. We believe having a culture that is accepting, supportive, diverse, and inclusive makes us all better. Provident has been a Bay Area “Top Workplace” since 2017, and our employees rank us on Glassdoor as one of the best credit unions in the nation.

Our values are:

  • Listen
  • Get Better
  • Do What’s Right

Essential Functions:

  • Develops project work plans with key milestones and dates; Executes and revises plans as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
  • Ensure project proposal and vendor management are completed by project owner.
  • Conducts project scoping including developing project scope statements, establishing KPIs to measure project success
  • Identifies resources needed, assigns individual responsibilities, and follow up accordingly.
  • Effectively applies Provident’s methodology and enforces project standards.
  • Minimizes Provident’s exposure and risk on project.
  • Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
  • Accurately tracks issues. Work closely with vendors and team members to ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Ensure departments develop and/or update procedures introduced by project.
  • Manages time effectively to meet project schedule and deadlines.
  • Assures the quality of work produced by ensuring that business practices and technical standards are adhered to and quality project delivered to specified standards.
  • Monitors project progress, regularly reports on progress, identifies and actions potential stoppers and issues. Escalates issues when appropriate.

Business Analysis & Solution Validation

  • Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams leveraging AI agents and tools.
  • Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.
  • Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.

Financial Management

  • Understands cost-and-benefit analysis and basis revenue models.
  • Understands basis project legal documents.
  • Understands basis budgeting processes
  • Understands Credit Union processes.

Communication

  • Facilitates team and client meetings effectively.
  • Holds Kick-off, Retrospective, and regular status meetings with project team.
  • Keeps project team well informed of changes occur throughout the project.
  • Effectively communicates relevant project information, both verbally and in writing, to superiors while confers and provides accurate monthly status report to project stakeholders and senior management as directed.
  • Delivers engaging, informative, well-organized presentations.
  • Understands how to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully.
  • Knowledge & Business Acumen

Financial & Operational Management

  • Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
  • Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
  • Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.
  • Working knowledge of Credit Union operations, products, services, and regulatory environment.
  • Ability to monitor project expenditures and identify budget variances.

Technical Understanding

  • Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and information technology concepts.
  • Understand web-based, cloud, internet, and client-server architectures.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Proficiency with project management and business analysis tools including Planview Adaptivework, Microsoft Project, OneNote, Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite, MS Teams, Artificial Intelligence tools, and other tools.

Professional Development & Compliance

  • Complete all required compliance and regulatory training, including BSA and OFAC training, on an annual basis.
  • Understand and comply with all applicable policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Participate in project management, and industry learning opportunities to maintain and expand professional knowledge.
  • Pursue and maintain professional certifications and continuing education relevant to project management and business analysis, such as PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related credentials.
  • Understand and adhere to BSA and OFAC policy and procedures.

Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional teams through influence and collaboration.
  • Foster accountability, ownership, and commitment to project objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend practical solutions.
  • Promote PMO standards, governance, and best practices.

Teamwork

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders, business units, support teams, and vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative, engaged, and results-oriented team environment.
  • Facilitate conflict resolution and promote effective communication among project participants.
  • Capture, document, and share lessons learned to support continuous improvement.

Internal Client and Vendor Management

  • Understand Provident's strategic objectives.
  • Manage day-to-day vendor relationships during the project duration and project communications.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure alignment between project outcomes and business objectives.
  • Continually seek opportunities to improve internal customer and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Build productive relationships with external vendors, consultants, and service providers.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Excellent listening and speaking skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Complete required BSA & OFAC training annually.
  • Understand and adhere to BSA and OFAC policy and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education/Work Experience/Skills/Abilities

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering and/or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience of relevant technology experience.
  • 8+ years of project management experience
  • 5+ years of Credit Union or relevant financial experience
  • 5+ years of business requirements gathering
  • A track record of successful overall management of an effective project team

Benefits you will enjoy:

  • Flexible spending accounts

title: Team Lead, Market Operations - Dallas (Hutchins), TX
description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About the team and position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment. We hire bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Job Description

The Team Lead, in our Market Operations group, is responsible for running the local Carvana hub and everything that comes with it, including (but not limited to); market launch, operations, logistics, consumer branding, team engagement and effectiveness and, of course, the market’s ongoing success. We are looking for someone who is a big picture thinker with the ability to manage the employee and customer experience. A Team Lead not only crushes daily operations, but they have the savvy to assess business trends and proactively create solutions to potential roadblocks. We need a strong people leader, as a Team Lead works closely with a team of extremely talented Customer Advocates and is responsible for providing vision and development opportunities.

What you’ll be Doing

  • Be a continuous positive force within the market and create strong morale and spirit throughout the team.
  • Help interview, select, onboard and train a team of Customer Advocates and provide the tools, resources and guidance they need to be successful. Employee development is an essential part of this role.
  • Actively develop a team of Customer Advocates by providing feedback, conducting performance check-ins, and setting goals to improve performance and skill set.
  • Recognize and reinforce individual and team accomplishments by using existing organizational tools and programs as well as by finding new, creative and effective methods of recognition.
  • Generate and monitor regular reports like a boss and presenting to upper management… also like a boss.
  • Be the go to expert for your team. You’re always ready to jump in alongside an Advocate to wash cars or jump into our kick-ass single-car hauler and deliver cars to our customers while providing a stellar customer experience.
  • Drive production in a fast-paced customer service environment and keep every detail of your market operating like a well oiled machine
  • Actively look for ways to improve the overall customer and Advocate team experience.
  • Address and effectively manage complex and sensitive customer-facing issues.

What you should have

  • 5+ years work experience in a customer facing team environment
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Proven history of developing and coaching employees
  • Prior experience with strategic planning, process improvement, and guiding teams to exceed goals
  • Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills
  • Ability to diagnose and solve problems with varying complexity while maintaining focus on the customer experience
  • Willingness to work on weekends
  • Enthusiasm and energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves

It would be great if you also had

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience with Salesforce or Tableau
  • An analytical mind
  • Experience handling logistics

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat.
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items up to 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual activity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires to work in outdoor weather conditions.
  • Must be able to stay in stationary positions for extended periods of time (when driving) up to 3 hours at a time.
  • Frequently communicates with customers and must be able to exchange accurate information

* California, Colorado, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Nevada, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia and Wisconsin employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Benefits Specialist
description:
Position Summary: The Benefits Specialist plays a key role in the administration, compliance, and continuous improvement of the organization’s employee benefits programs. Working with a high degree of independence, this position manages day-to-day operations, interprets plan documents and regulatory requirements, advises employees and managers, and partners with vendors to ensure effective service delivery. The Benefits Specialist contributes to process optimization, data integrity, and program enhancements that support the organization’s overall total rewards strategy. This position will be fully onsite in Lake Oswego, OR office.

Salary Range: $65,000 - $80,000 DOE

Essential Responsibilities:

Benefits Administration Support

  • Administer employee benefits programs including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement, and voluntary plans.
  • Review and interpret plan documents to ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
  • Manage qualifying life events, enrollments, terminations, and benefit changes accurately and on time.
  • Reconcile benefit invoices, validate payroll deductions, and resolve discrepancies.
  • Serve as primary liaison with benefits carriers, brokers, and vendors; escalate complex issues as necessary.
  • Lead preparation and execution of annual open enrollment, including communication materials, employee education, and enrollment system updates.
  • Conduct audits of benefits records to ensure data integrity in HRIS and other systems.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Prepare reports and dashboards on benefit utilization, leave trends, and cost analysis for HR leadership.
  • Maintain plan documentation, employee records, and required notices in accordance with legal and company requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits and compliance reviews.

Employee and Leadership Support

  • Advise employees and managers on benefits programs, policies, and procedures.
  • Conduct ongoing benefits education sessions.
  • Assist HR leadership in analyzing benefit trends, evaluating plan effectiveness, and recommending improvements.

Process Improvement & Professional Development

  • Identify opportunities to streamline benefits and leave administration processes.
  • Stay current on benefits, leave laws, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in HR initiatives related to total rewards, employee experience, or system enhancements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
  • 3-5 years of experience in benefits administration, ideally including FMLA, ADA, and state paid leave programs.
  • Experience with HRIS systems, payroll interfaces, and vendor management.
  • Prior experience conducting benefits audits and supporting compliance initiatives preferred.

Position Related Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer service mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with HRIS system preferred.

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position in an office environment more than 85% of the time.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, computers or printer.
  • The worker is required to have the ability to perform duties such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; reading printed and digital documents.
  • Constantly required to communicate with customers and coworkers in an office setting, on the phone and in digital meetings.
  • Constantly required to coach, train, lead and talk to individuals and groups in-person, and remotely.
  • The majority of work is performed in an office setting, with minimal time spent outdoors in all types of weather conditions and exposure.
  • Constant mental alertness, accuracy, and attention to detail required.
  • Must be able to work independently, make decisions, and follow through on all assignments.
  • Must use creativity, independent judgment, discernment, and organizational and problem-solving skills to determine best method to accomplish desired results.

title: Technology Enablement Program Manager
description:
Humankind is on a mission.

We are transforming healthcare.

We are empowering individuals to put emotional health first.


Who we are.

We are on a mission to transform mental and emotional healthcare. Using data and “machine smarts” we find the people who need help before they crash into the system. We don’t wait for things to get worse. Our unique approach combines both the heart of clinical care management and the science of machine learning to transform the health and wellbeing of large populations. From workplace pressures to financial challenges, marital struggles, and behavioral health issues, our teams deliver the kind of support that makes a measurable difference in the lives of the individuals and families we serve.


Why we need you.

We’re growing and building a hand-picked team of positive, optimistic, empathetic rockstars. We are looking for passionate humans to join our multi-disciplinary team of professionals and inspire hope for “the other eleven” to live their best life. Let’s do this.


Who you are.

You are passionate, open minded, and you make a daily difference in the lives of those around you. You are the person people ask for help, guidance, and direction. You are an optimist. You remove obstacles. And just like us, you wear your H.E.A.R.T. on your sleeve with Hope, Empathy, a preference for Action, a willingness to Raise the bar, and a belief that Trust is at the core of every meaningful relationship.


What you’ll do (Essential Job Functions)

title: Postdoctoral Fellow-MSH-30001-339
description:
Postdoctoral fellow in rare disease genetics at Mount Sinai School of Medicine

An exciting opportunity for a postdoctoral fellow is available jointly in the research groups of Dr Ernest Turro and Dr Tamas Kozicz in the Department of Genetics and Genomic Sciences at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, New York.

The postholder will undertake a mix of statistical and experimental work to understand the pathophysiology of neurodevelopmental disorders. The research environment in both groups will provide ample opportunities to work on individual and team projects, with excellent publication prospects and opportunities for personal growth. The postholder will initially be supported by a mix of an R01 grant awarded to Dr Turro by the NIH NHLBI and institutional funding.

The candidate must hold a PhD in biomedical science and have strong statistical and programming proficiency with proven expertise in genomic analysis, including the analysis of high-throughput sequencing data and statistical approaches in genomics. Experience working with cellular models of neurodevelopmental disorders is also a pre-requisite, including genetic engineering, cellular reprogramming and differentiation, and phenotyping of neurons or brain organoids. Knowledge of bioinformatics software tools and databases for genetic analyses is a strong advantage. Experience working on a high-performance computing cluster is essential. The successful candidate will be familiar with commonly used software packages in the biological sciences and will have experience in using and, ideally, developing R or Python bioinformatics packages. The candidate will also have strong organizational and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work productively as a member of a team. A personal motivation to understand the biological determinants of rare diseases is desired. Fluency in English is required.

  • Monitoring and maintaining version control of the different discipline models.

  • Identifying design inconsistencies, clashes and unresolved coordination issues through 3D clash detection and model review sessions.
  • Analysing potential causes of design conflicts and reporting findings to the Design Manager.
  • Planning, organising and chairing BIM coordination meetings.
  • Acting as the key point of contact for Design Leads regarding geometric interfaces and associated control measurements.
  • Supporting BIM Leads and project teams with software-related and technical BIM questions.
  • Ensuring the overall quality, consistency and reliability of BIM models throughout the project.
  • Maintaining a structured modelling environment that facilitates efficient collaboration and information exchange between all stakeholders.

  • You hold a Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering or Architecture.
  • You are fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is an asset.
  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a BIM Engineer/BIM Coordinator. Experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects (above €25 million) is considered a strong asset.

title: Transit Engineering Lead
description:
Job Description

Saylor Consulting Group is seeking an experienced Engineering Lead to support our client, the Transbay Joint Powers Authority (TJPA), on The Portal (Downtown Rail Extension) program in San Francisco. The role supports delivery of the 40-CT Civil & Tunnel Progressive Design-Build (PDB) contract. It is a hybrid position: the individual must report to the project trailer in downtown San Francisco at least three days per week. The assignment is expected to last several years at 40 hours per week.

The start date is urgent. Half-time availability between now and February 2027 can be accommodated, with full-time work after that. We would also consider an immediate full-time start for the right candidate.

Reporting to the 40-CT Package Manager, the Engineering Lead will lead and coordinate the technical and engineering activities associated with this major underground infrastructure package. The 40-CT scope includes:

  • an underground station
  • utility relocation
  • shafts and Sequential Excavation Method (SEM) tunneling
  • cut-and-cover tunneling with traffic decking

The role calls for strong experience integrating complex underground transit projects, including civil works, temporary works, construction methodology, and multidisciplinary design, in a dense urban environment. The Engineering Lead will work closely with the Integrated Program Management Team (IPMT), the General Engineering Consultant (GEC), the PDB contractor, and third parties. The goal is to make sure engineering development supports safe, constructible, and cost-effective delivery of the package.

Duties

  • Serve as the technical and engineering lead for the 40-CT package, reporting to and supporting the Package Manager.
  • Lead coordination and integration of engineering across underground station architecture, station fit-out, tunneling, geotechnical, structural, civil, utilities, temporary works and underground station disciplines.
  • Oversee technical development of the PDB contractor’s design and coordinate review of design submissions for compliance with project requirements.

title: Director, Supply Chain Strategy
description:
Overview

Purpose:

Dole Packaged Foods is a purpose led organization that is a champion of accessible fruit nutrition and builds a brighter future for people through the goodness of fruit.

At Dole, our culture is uniquely driven by core Values. Our commitment to these Values transforms our work into a meaningful journey toward a brighter future together. Here, you'll be part of a respectful, inclusive culture that deeply values our colleagues, customers, and global communities. We strive for excellence, empowering each other to confidently overcome challenges, continuously learn, and achieve world-class results. Guided by unwavering integrity, our actions consistently reflect our commitment to always doing what's right, fostering lasting trust and strong relationships. Through a spirit of collaboration, we cultivate positivity, generosity, and genuine teamwork, enabling collective success toward our One Dole Purpose. Our innovative spirit leads directly to meaningful outcomes and business success.

The Director, Supply Chain Strategy leads the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of core supply chain processes across the North America enterprise. This role owns strategic planning, end-to-end performance analytics, and transformation initiatives that elevate service levels, cost efficiency, working capital, and team effectiveness. The Director drives a culture of accountability, collaboration, data-driven decision making, and operational excellence across the supply chain network.

Reporting to the Vice President, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, this leader builds and maintains a high-performing team spanning analytics, strategic planning, information technology enablement, project management, and performance improvement. The Director plays a pivotal enterprise role by connecting cross-functional efforts across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Customer Supply Chain to ensure seamless end-to-end supply chain integration.

This role provides flexibility to work in a hybrid environment of home and our Westlake Village, CA office. (Hybrid is defined as 3 times per week in the office).

Responsibilities

Primary Accountabilities:

Strategic Planning

  • Set and align the strategic vision for North America Supply Chain with enterprise objectives, long-range targets, and operating model priorities.
  • Own the annual strategic planning process, governance model, and cadence across all Supply Chain functions, ensuring cross-functional alignment and executive buy-in.
  • Drive scenario planning and decision-support frameworks that enable leadership to evaluate trade-offs in cost, service, and capital investment.
  • Translate enterprise strategy into actionable multi-year Supply Chain roadmaps with clear milestones, owners, and success metrics.
  • Lead quarterly strategy reviews and executive-level reporting to measure progress and recalibrate priorities.

Project Management

  • Establish and manage a robust Supply Chain project management framework to govern, track, and report on key Supply Chain initiatives across functions and geographies.
  • Provide oversight and accountability for major cross-functional programs, including operating model implementation, network redesign, system deployments, and transformation projects.
  • Define project charters, resource requirements, milestone timelines, risk registers, and benefits realization plans for all strategic Supply Chain programs.
  • Coordinate with executive stakeholders and functional leaders to ensure milestones, budgets, and outcomes are achieved on time and within scope.
  • Implement structured stage-gate governance processes that create rigor, transparency, and predictable delivery across the project portfolio.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Oversee the design and execution of advanced analytics, dashboards, and performance scorecards that drive improvement in service levels, inventory turns, transportation cost, manufacturing run efficiency, and customer fill rates.
  • Champion data standards, central system governance, and a single source of truth across the supply chain data ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive Supply Chain KPI framework; lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews with leadership and functional teams.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and demand signals to proactively identify supply risk, capacity constraints, and service failure points before they occur.
  • Coach functional teams on data literacy, analytical tools, and insights-driven decision making to elevate the overall analytics capability of the organization.

Information Technology

  • Partner with IT and Digital to modernize supply chain data platforms, planning tools, and execution systems to enable real-time visibility and integrated decision support.
  • Lead the supply chain technology roadmap, including ERP enhancements and AI application.
  • Define business requirements and serve as the Supply Chain business owner for major technology implementations, integrations, and upgrades.
  • Evaluate emerging supply chain technologies — including AI, machine learning, and automation — and lead pilots that deliver measurable operational value.
  • Ensure data governance, system reliability, and change management practices are embedded into all technology rollout plans.

Benchmarking

  • Lead ongoing internal and external benchmarking of supply chain capabilities, costs, service performance, and operating practices against industry peers and best-in-class CPG companies.
  • Ensure benchmarking insights are visible, well understood, and actively used to prioritize improvement initiatives and set aspirational performance targets.
  • Maintain relationships with industry associations, third-party benchmarking providers, and advisory networks to access current market data and emerging practices.
  • Build a structured benchmarking cadence that feeds the annual strategic planning cycle and informs leadership decision making.
  • Translate external benchmarks into actionable recommendations and business cases that align with enterprise investment priorities.

Transformation

  • Lead large-scale supply chain transformation initiatives, including network optimization, operating model redesign, and organizational capability building across the North America enterprise.
  • Act as a visible change agent who communicates clearly, reduces resistance, and builds alignment at all levels of the organization during periods of significant change.
  • Develop and execute change management plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and communication frameworks to ensure successful adoption of new processes, tools, and structures.
  • Drive productivity and cost optimization initiatives across warehousing, transportation, manufacturing, planning and customer supply chain through structured CI methodologies (e.g., Lean, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping).
  • Establish benefits realization tracking to validate that transformation investments deliver the projected financial and operational outcomes.

End-to-End Supply Chain Integration

  • Own the governance and integration framework that connects Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Commercial functions into a unified, end-to-end operating model.
  • Ensure the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process, cadence, and governance across Demand, Supply, Finance, and Commercial is fully aligned to our strategic volume, capacity, inventory, and financial commitments.
  • Break down functional silos by establishing cross-functional operating rhythms, shared KPIs, and collaborative problem-solving forums.
  • Drive end-to-end supply chain visibility by connecting upstream supply and production signals to downstream fulfillment and customer service outcomes.
  • Ensure supplier performance, contract manufacturing partnerships, and 3PL relationships are integrated into the end-to-end supply chain strategy and performance management framework.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Experience, Knowledge, & Skills You Bring:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in supply chain, operations, IBP, network planning, or analytics, preferably within the CPG, food & beverage, or consumer products sector.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading end-to-end supply chain transformation and large-scale, cross-functional change initiatives.
  • Deep experience in S&OP/IBP processes, demand and supply planning, logistics optimization, and supply chain analytics.
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing teams across multiple functional disciplines.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills — able to drive alignment across senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex data and analytics into strategic insight, clear recommendations, and actionable plans.
  • Proficiency with advanced supply chain planning systems, ERP platforms (e.g., SAP), data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and project management frameworks.
  • Expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, or structured continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen; ability to build business cases, manage P&L trade-offs, and demonstrate ROI on supply chain investments.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, matrixed organization with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Passionate about a purpose driven career
  • Cultivates respectful and inclusive environments that support employee growth across teams
  • Drives strategic initiatives and maintains excellence in complex and dynamic settings
  • Establishes transparent decision-making and accountability frameworks
  • Encourages organizational teamwork effectively to achieve shared objectives

Education & Certification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field required.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit and use the computer for extended periods of time; ability to answer phones and use a variety of office equipment; ability to lift 15 pounds and reach overhead.

Travel Requirements:

  • Estimated 20-25% travel required to regional distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and external partner sites.
  • Some international travel may be required based on business needs.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

FOR JOBS BASED IN CALIFORNIA:

Hiring Pay Scale: $195,000 to $215,000

Dole Packaged Foods is committed to paying our Associates fairly and equitably. The pay rate offered will consider a wide range of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, accomplishments, and location. Pay scales are subject to review on a regular basis and will be updated as appropriate.

title: Test Engineer II
description:
Elevate Your Flight Experience with Honeywell Aerospace Avionics

At Honeywell Aerospace, we understand that avionics are the backbone of every flight, providing essential information and control for pilots around the globe. Our advanced avionics systems are designed to improve safety, operational efficiency, and facilitate seamless navigation, ensuring pilots can focus on what matters most—flying.

With decades of experience in aerospace technology, Honeywell Aerospace is committed to delivering innovative avionics solutions that meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. Our systems are crafted to reduce pilot workload and support decision-making, making every flight safer and more efficient.

Explore our range of avionics products, including Includes Airplane Information Management System, Autopilots and Indicators, Cockpit and Flight Displays, Control Display Units, Flight Data Recorders, Flight Management Systems, Integrated Flight Decks and Synthetic Vision Systems. Discover how Honeywell can support your aviation needs, ensuring that every flight is a triumph in safety and precision.

As a Test Engineer II here at Honeywell Aerospace Technologies, you will support production, customer service, and developmental programs by maintaining, troubleshooting, improving, and expanding test equipment and test stations. This role requires strong hands-on problem-solving skills, effective collaboration across engineering and production teams, and the ability to develop creative solutions that keep critical test operations running reliably.

In this role, you will play a key role as part of a multidisciplinary team, supporting for both hardware and software engineering, contributing to essential projects that drive the future of aerospace Navigation, Inertial Sensing and hardware systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Repair and maintain legacy Surface test stations, using creative and practical solutions to ensure equipment remains operational and supports the product line.
  • Set up and improve vibration display board systems so technicians can control multiple test stations from a central location. Support improvements that allow stations to be moved into adjacent work areas while optimizing available space.
  • Restore and maintain legacy simulators to provide a reliable production backup and eliminate single points of failure. Coordinate with engineering to protect development activities when production equipment requires support.
  • Support the Customer Service Center by ensuring test equipment is functioning properly and answering questions regarding the correct methods for testing Return Goods (RGs).
  • Support developmental programs and collaborate with the PR Software Team to troubleshoot issues, brainstorm solutions, and implement effective fixes.
  • Upgrade Test Stations to newer Windows Versions. .
  • Perform general troubleshooting of units, test stations, and rate tables in response to production and engineering support needs.
  • Assist with calibration tracking and develop processes that improve equipment visibility, readiness, and long-term maintainability.
  • Document troubleshooting activities, equipment modifications, test results, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with technicians, software engineers, production personnel, and other engineering teams to resolve test-related issues efficiently.

Required Qualifications
• Experience troubleshooting production test equipment, test stations, simulators, or related electronic systems.
• Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical, reliable solutions.
• Experience supporting cross-functional teams and communicating technical information clearly to engineers and technicians.
• Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple support requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Strong documentation, organization, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field.
• Experience with legacy equipment modernization, hardware retrofits, or operating system migrations.
• Experience supporting vibration testing, simulators, production test systems, or automated test equipment.
• Knowledge of calibration tracking and equipment-control processes.
• ESD certification or related training; completion of an iNARTE ESD Monitor course is preferred.
• Experience working with defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated production environments.

Skills and Competencies
• Electrical and electronic test equipment troubleshooting
• Legacy system repair and modernization
• Production and developmental test support
• Hardware and software integration
• Root-cause analysis and corrective action
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Technical communication and documentation
• Continuous improvement and creative problem-solving

Work Environment
The Test Engineer II works closely with production, customer service, software, and engineering personnel to maintain test readiness and minimize interruptions to critical operations. The role may require hands-on work with electronic equipment, test stations, simulators, and related production systems.

U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIREMENTS

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
• Short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
• Employee assistance program and educational assistance
• Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
• Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
Explore your benefits:

ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

ABOUT HONEYWELL ELECTRONIC SOLUTIONS

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses:

Honeywell Aerospace Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30-plus years in service to radiation-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.

title: Børnehuset Korshøjvej søger en dygtig og engageret vuggestuepædagog (Genopslag)
description:
Børnehuset Korshøjvej er et ungt børnehus med høje ambitioner for både børn og medarbejdere. Vi arbejder målrettet på at skabe et trygt, inspirerende og udviklende børnemiljø, hvor leg, nærvær og høj pædagogisk faglighed går hånd i hånd.

Drømmer du om en moderne arbejdsplads med fantastiske rammer tæt på sø og skov, en stor nyanlagt legeplads og engagerede kollegaer, som brænder for at skabe de bedste betingelser for børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et børnehus, hvor dine idéer bliver hørt, og hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den fortsatte udvikling af vores pædagogiske praksis? Så håber vi, at du har lyst til at blive en del af vores fællesskab.

Hos os er høj pædagogisk kvalitet noget, vi udvikler sammen. Vi er optagede af at skabe de bedste rammer for børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse, og vi tror på, at det kræver både faglig nysgerrighed, stærke relationer og et tæt samarbejde. Derfor prioriterer vi sparring, videndeling og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi tager ansvar for vores fælles kerneopgave og for hinanden.

Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og omsorgsfuld, og motiveres du af at indgå i et fagligt stærkt team, som hver dag arbejder for at skabe udviklende børnemiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.


Om Børnehuset Korshøjvej

Vores børnehus er et moderne modulbyggeri med plads til 102 børn. I dag består huset af to vuggestuegrupper med 30 børn og to børnehavegrupper med 52 børn. På sigt flytter vi ind i et helt nyt børnehus, og vi håber, at du får lyst til at være med på den spændende rejse.

Vi er 17 engagerede medarbejdere bestående af seks pædagoger, ni pædagogmedhjælpere, en pædagogisk assistent, en køkkenmedarbejder og en daglig leder. Du bliver en del af en velfungerende medarbejdergruppe med stærk samarbejdsvilje, høj faglighed og en uhøjtidelig omgangstone præget af humor, latter og selvironi. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi løfter opgaverne i fællesskab.

Du kan læse mere om Børnehuset Korshøjvej og de øvrige børnehuse i Virklund-Sydbyen her:


Vi tilbyder
  • En fast stilling på 37 timer eller et andet timetal efter aftale.
  • Engagerede kollegaer, der aktivt bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med fokus på udvikling, refleksion og kvalitet.
  • Et pædagogisk fundament, hvor relationer, tryghed og trivsel danner grundlaget for børns udvikling, læring og dannelse.
  • Inspirerende læringsmiljøer med fokus på leg, deltagelsesmuligheder og stærke fællesskaber.
  • Et tæt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med forældrene.
  • To inklusionspædagoger, som tilbyder sparring og understøttende forløb, når der er behov.
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af et børnehus, der fortsat er i rivende udvikling.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Vi forventer, at du
  • Er uddannet pædagog.
  • Har erfaring med – eller lyst til – at arbejde med børn i alderen 0-3 år.
  • Tager aktivt medansvar for at skabe de bedste betingelser for børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse.
  • Arbejder nærværende og har blik for børnenes perspektiver, ressourcer og medbestemmelse.
  • Møder børn, forældre og kollegaer med varme, nysgerrighed og respekt.
  • Bidrager aktivt til et professionelt teamsamarbejde og et stærkt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Bevarer overblikket og er med til at skabe struktur i en hverdag, hvor tempoet til tider er højt.
  • Er fleksibel og ser samarbejde som en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at være ansat i Silkeborg Kommunes dagtilbud, eller ønsker du at læse om medarbejdergoder, kompetenceudvikling, vores faglige fundament samt visioner og værdier, kan du læse mere på Silkeborg Kommunes hjemmeside.

Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning elektronisk via knappen Ansøg. Husk at vedhæfte relevante bilag.

Vi indhenter offentlig straffeattest og børneattest på den person, vi ønsker at ansætte.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Detail Lead
description:
About Us

South Bay Solutions is a high-precision machine shop serving the semiconductor, medical device, and advanced technology industries. We manufacture complex components with tolerances measured in microns using state-of-the-art equipment and a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and quality.



Position Summary

South Bay Solutions is seeking an experienced and motivated Detail Lead to oversee daily detailing operations and ensure all parts are cleaned, polished, and prepared to company quality standards.

This position is responsible for leading the detailing team, maintaining workflow efficiency, enforcing quality standards, and coordinating with production and quality departments to support manufacturing schedules and on-time deliveries.

The ideal candidate has hands-on detailing experience in a machine shop or manufacturing environment, strong leadership skills, and a commitment to maintaining high standards in a fast-paced production setting.



Schedule

Day Shift
Monday-Friday
9:00 AM-5:35 PM



Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Coordination

  • Assign daily tasks and monitor team performance.
  • Train and mentor detailing technicians on proper techniques, equipment operation, and safety procedures.
  • Foster a positive, productive, and team-oriented work environment.
  • Provide coaching and support to ensure quality and productivity goals are achieved.

Quality Control

  • Inspect completed parts to ensure cleanliness, finish quality, and compliance with company standards.
  • Identify quality concerns and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Maintain consistency in detailing processes and workmanship.

Workflow & Scheduling

  • Prioritize work according to production schedules and customer delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate with Production, Quality, Shipping, and other departments to maintain efficient workflow.
  • Monitor job status and adjust priorities to meet deadlines.

Equipment & Inventory Management

  • Ensure proper use and maintenance of detailing equipment and tools.
  • Monitor inventory levels of detailing supplies and coordinate replenishment as needed.
  • Maintain organized and efficient workstations and storage areas.

Safety & Compliance

  • Enforce OSHA standards and company safety policies.
  • Ensure proper handling and storage of cleaning products and chemicals.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment.



Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in machine shop detailing, manufacturing finishing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Previous Lead, Supervisor, or Team Lead experience preferred.



Skills & Abilities

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of cleaning, polishing, deburring, and detailing techniques.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.



Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Comfortable working around machinery, cleaning chemicals, and industrial equipment.





Benefits

  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance for Employees
  • Life Insurance
  • Safe Harbor 401(k)
  • Company 401(k) Match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick Time, Holidays, and Floating Holiday
  • Employee Referral Program

title: Director of Restaurant and Bars
