title: Construction Project Manager
description:
​ ​​

Construction Project Manager

Location: Hybrid/Seattle (1-3 days/wk in office, very flexible)

Type: Full-Time

About ForestVision.ai

We are building the AI layer the $340B global timber industry has been waiting for. Today, the industry relies on a 200-year-old volume formula and manual tape measures to manage high-value log loads, resulting in 17–35% estimation errors. We are replacing this with patented multimodal computer vision and AI agents deployed directly at the truck scale—the most leveraged data moment in the supply chain. By eliminating these inaccuracies, we directly support sustainable resource management and better stewardship of our natural forests.

Unlike competitors who rely on consumer smartphones for mobile, decentralized setups, ForestVision.ai deploys fixed, industrial-grade camera rigs and edge-computing boxes specifically designed for high-throughput mill entryways. We don’t just output predictions; we generate a state-certified audit trail that transforms raw pixels into deterministic, industry-standard measurements.

Focus Areas

Forest Vision is seeking an experienced construction manager to support the rapid expansion of the Forest Vision Log Scaling system. This involves developing standard processes and procedures for new site development, coordinating and planning installations with customers, managing all aspects of the installation process, and building out the vendor network as needed across the NW. As the installation base grows, you'll have opportunities to take on leadership roles and help build a nationwide installation and maintenance network. Candidates with relevant project and program experience will also have opportunities to contribute to the engineering and software development efforts.

What You Will Do

  • Develop a standard process for evaluating, installing, and onboarding a new mill site to the Forest Vision system.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to produce design packages for contractors and technicians to install the Forest Vision Log Scaling System at mills.
  • Perform initial mill site surveys and develop workflow proposals and installation plans.
  • Evaluate, contract, and manage vendors to install the Forest Vision Log Scaling System at new mills, including electrical, steel fabrication, and foundations.
  • Coordinate and manage the installation process with all stakeholders (Suppliers, vendors, mill staff, permitting agencies, utilities).
  • Manage the budgets and quality of all installation projects.
  • Contract and manage contract vendors or internal staff to perform routine maintenance
  • Manage the procurement and/or fabrication of all components and subassemblies to install and maintain the Forest Vision Log Scaling Systems.
  • Forecast for upcoming installations and maintain inventory to meet the deployment schedule.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of work experience in a relevant industry.
  • 3+ years of experience doing construction management or project management in an industrial setting with infrastructure projects.
  • Experience constructing or installing industrial buildings, industrial equipment, traffic control, street lighting, weight scales, or other relevant projects.
  • Familiar with the permitting process for buildings and industrial equipment.
  • A working knowledge of basic electrical, steel fabrication, concrete foundations, etc.
  • Manage budgets for construction or manufacturing.
  • Vendor negotiation, management, and quality control.
  • Previous experience as a millwright, general contractor, or tradesperson is desirable but not required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Physical and Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel frequently to regional mills (up to 50% travel may be required depending on project phases). This person would start with the western region, including mills in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Northern California.
  • Ability to navigate active industrial environments, climb ladders, and walk rugged construction sites

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a millwright, general contractor or tradesperson desirable.
  • Direct experience with at least one of the following: steel, concrete, and electrical installation.
  • Direct experience with mills or similar weigh station construction.
  • CCM and PMP certifications.
  • Ability to perform some maintenance and installation tasks when needed. May require working from a mobile elevated work platform.
  • Related experience installing street lighting, highway signage, traffic signals, telecommunications towers, large-scale industrial equipment, etc.

Future Responsibilities

  • Manage Safety Program at FV and with Vendors
  • Manage a team of project coordinators and installation or maintenance technicians
Join Us

We are looking for an early, high-impact Construction Project Manager with a mind for forest conservation, excited to build a product with real-world impact to implement our Forest Vision log measuring system at all our client sites.

The Construction Project Manager position offers a base salary range of $140,000 to $190,000, along with equity and comprehensive benefits. Please note that this range serves as a guideline; actual total compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, skill set, qualifications, and geographic location.

title: Special Project: Pelletizer/Grinder Operator (Temp to Perm)
description:
At Darnel Group, we focus on what truly matters—environmental, economic, and social sustainability. The Pelletizer/Grinder Operator is responsible for grinding scrap from the extrusion process, monitoring the pelletizing processes while producing a variety of pellets from fluff as per order specification reporting any machinery inconsistencies to the Supervisor, Shift Lead and/or Manager. This role ensures equipment is functioning correctly and complies with safety and quality standards.


This position will start out temporary and covert to a Darnel Regular Employee after 90 days and successful onboarding.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Set up and start up grinders or pelletizers. Load material and make adjustments as needed.
  • Support extrusion operations including stringing the line, doffing rolls, and grinding scrap.
  • Record and monitor scrap grinding operations and line settings to react quickly.
  • Ensure quality of the product by use of calipers, scales, micrometers and/or other measurement devices or equipment.
  • Prepare and complete daily documentation including logs, tracking reports, and computer data entry.
  • Identify and report machinery issues to the Lead Operator, Supervisor, or Manager; communicate repair needs to maintenance.
  • Maintain cleanliness of machines, floors, and waste in assigned area.
  • Operate forklift to move, stage, and retrieve raw materials; ensure smooth shift transitions by preparing materials for the next shift.
  • Use PeopleSoft to report production, generate labels, and record product consumption.

NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in cross-training for various extrusion processing equipment including blending systems, vacuum systems, screen changers, extruder controls, and winders.
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as assigned by management.

title: Director of Design
description:
Innovate with purpose

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

We're hiring a Director of Design to own what BILL looks like everywhere it shows up. Every campaign, web experience, video, event, and template that carries the BILL name runs through this team, and the bar for all of it is yours to set. That means leading in-house designers across brand, campaign, motion, and graphic design, and working with agency partners to execute at a high bar.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work alongside the leaders of Brand, Web, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, Demand Gen, and Product Design. The team you are stepping into has strong talent and real systems. Your job is to grow it and take the visual representation of BILL somewhere bolder and more innovative. This is a leadership job first. You'll spend most of your time on people, process, and partnerships. You'll also stay close enough to the work to concept, art direct, and, when it matters, open the file yourself.

What you'll do

  • Lead and grow a team. Set the bar, run critiques worth showing up for, and build a culture where great designers get better.
  • Set the creative vision for the BILL brand and drive it through campaigns, web, product marketing, event signage, swag, and more. Make BILL look like nothing else in the category.
  • Rebuild how the team works around AI: which tools we use for concepting, production, and versioning, where the guardrails are, and how intake, briefing, and review change so output grows faster than headcount.
  • Build video production into something the team ships every week, not occasionally. Decide what we staff, contract, and send to agencies, and put the pipeline and review process in place to ship at a steady cadence.
  • Own the brand design system: the standards, templates, and governance that Marketing, agencies, and internal teams build from, and that hold up under real production pressure.
  • Run the team end to end like an agency. Own intake, prioritization, and capacity across disciplines; lead the weekly prioritization forum; and manage the budget, contractors, and agency relationships from RFP to delivery.
  • Partner with Brand on positioning and expression, with Web on the site and conversion testing, and with Product Design on keeping the brand whole from first ad to first login.
  • Write the briefs for the big work, present it to senior leadership, and make the team’s contribution to the business legible.
  • Hire, develop, and keep great designers.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in design, with at least four leading a multidisciplinary in-house creative team, including managing Creative Directors or other people managers.
  • A portfolio with two kinds of receipts: work you made, and work your team made under your direction. Brand and campaign work with a clear point of view.
  • Experience building and governing a brand design system in a fast-moving company, and keeping it in use.
  • Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into a creative team's workflow, with a real opinion on where they help, where they don't, and how you protect quality along the way.
  • Experience producing video and motion for marketing, either directly or by building the team and vendor mix to do it.
  • Experience running agencies, contractors, and a budget from RFP through delivery.
  • Comfort represents design to C-level partners, making the case for creative quality with clarity and data, and saying no when the work doesn't meet the bar.
  • Craft depth across Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, motion and video tools like After Effects and Premiere, and AI-assisted workflows. Enough to evaluate and lift the team's work, and to contribute when needed.
  • Bonus points if you've led design through a brand transformation, shaped how AI features get expressed visually in a product people trust with their money, partnered with web and growth teams on redesigns and conversion testing, or worked in fintech or another regulated industry.

What success looks like

  • BILL's brand looks distinctive, modern, and unmistakably ours across every channel, and the market notices.
  • The design team ships more, faster, with AI built into how the work gets made, and the craft is better, not worse.
  • Video is a standing capability with a pipeline, a cadence, and a body of work: social ads, product explainers, and launch films.
  • Brand, Web, and Demand gen partners describe the team as an enabler, not a bottleneck.
  • The team is innovative and growing. People want to work here. You’re shipping work that makes everyone at BILL proud of where they work.

How we work

We move fast, take real positions, and would rather ship fewer, sharper ideas than fill a calendar. We value clear thinking, direct feedback, and the willingness to say no to work that doesn't meet the bar.

What’s in it for you?

Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn’t only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well.

Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL:

Don’t believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages.

We are committed to a transparent, inclusive hiring process that reflects our values. If you need accommodations at any stage, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com. Doing so will result in a review and potential disqualification.

title: AI-Native Engineer, New Grad (Hybrid)
description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.


Ready to start your career at full speed?

What you’ll actually do
  • Ship production code in your first weeks — real features, real customers, real money moving.
  • Own features end to end: design, build, test, deploy, watch the metrics, fix what you broke.
  • Use AI across your workflow — coding, debugging, testing, research, automating the boring parts — and push the frontier of how your team uses it, not just how you do.
  • Work directly with Product, Design, and senior engineers. Ask the dumb question early; it’s cheaper than the wrong build.
  • Learn the domain deeply. B2B fintech in LatAm is genuinely hard — multiple countries, multiple regulators, real consequences. That’s what makes it interesting.
  • Relocation to CDMX is encouraged and supported
Two tracks — tell us which one fits you
Product Engineering (fullstack, backend-leaning) Backend services, APIs, and the interfaces on top of them. Our stack leans Java/Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and AWS — but we don’t expect you to have used all of it. We expect you to have gone deep on something and to pick up the rest fast.
Data & ML Engineering Pipelines, models, and the systems that make them useful in production — risk scoring, fraud signals, spend intelligence. Python, SQL, and modern data tooling. Applied and in production, not just notebooks.

Who you are
  • You’re at the start of your software career. Whether you finished your degree last month or took a different route to get here, this role is scoped for engineers without prior full-time software experience — and we’ll treat you accordingly.
  • A technical foundation. CS, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similar — or equivalent ability you can demonstrate in code.
  • You’ve built things, and you can point at them. A GitHub, a deployed app, a repo people actually use, a hackathon win, a contribution to open source, a bot that solved a real problem for real users. One thing you built and can defend in depth beats a list of ten you touched.
  • You’re AI-native and you can prove it. Not “I’ve used ChatGPT.” We mean: you’ve built with AI — agents, RAG, evals, fine-tunes, a tool that automates something you were sick of doing — and you use AI tools every day in how you code. Come ready to show us the artifact and walk us through the decisions.
  • Strong fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, systems thinking. Competitive programming (ICPC, OMI, Codeforces), a strong thesis, or serious research all count and we want to hear about them.
  • English proficiency. English is our corporate language — you’ll read, write, and discuss technical work in it daily.
  • Ownership. You surface problems before they become blockers, you push things over the finish line, and you don’t wait to be told what to do. This is the single trait we screen hardest for.

Nice to haves

  • Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.

  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one

  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara’s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

### Description

**COMMUNITY & CEMETERY SERVICES INTERN**

Unpaid Internship | Flexible Schedule | Professional Experience in Local Government

**Turn your education into meaningful public service experience.**

Are you a college student or recent graduate interested in helping people, developing professional skills, and learning how local government serves its community?

The City of Redlands is seeking motivated individuals for an **unpaid Community & Cemetery Services Internship**. This opportunity provides hands-on exposure to municipal operations while helping support one of the City's most important community services. Cemetery Services is about much more than maintaining records and coordinating services. Our team works directly with community members who may be navigating the loss of a loved one and need someone who can provide clear information, compassion, patience, professionalism, and dependable assistance.

Interns will receive appropriate training and supervision and will not be expected to independently manage sensitive situations without staff support.

Internship duration and weekly hours will be established at the time of placement. Depending upon the needs of the City, the intern's availability, educational objectives, and continued progress in the program, internship participation may continue for an extended period, **up to one year where appropriate**.

### Examples of Duties

**WHAT YOU'LL GAIN**

This internship is designed as a learning and professional development opportunity. Depending upon assignment, interests, and demonstrated proficiency, interns may gain experience in:

- Local government and public-sector operations;
- Providing compassionate and professional customer service;
- Communicating with individuals and families experiencing difficult or significant life events;
- Administrative processes, documentation, and records management;
- Professional telephone, email, and in-person communication;
- Coordinating services and responding to public inquiries;
- Researching records and helping community members locate information;
- Maintaining confidential or sensitive information appropriately;
- Organizing files, databases, forms, correspondence, and other records;
- Working collaboratively with City staff and outside service providers;
- Managing competing priorities in a professional office environment; and
- Understanding how municipal services are delivered to the community.

As knowledge and proficiency develop, interns may receive progressively more complex assignments and opportunities to learn about other aspects of City operations.

**WHO SHOULD APPLY?**

We are interested in candidates who want to learn, serve their community, and develop professional experience. This opportunity may be especially valuable for current students or recent graduates studying:

**Social Work • Sociology • Psychology • Human Services • Public Administration • Business Administration • Communications • Public Relations • Behavioral Sciences • Organizational Leadership • or related fields**

Students exploring a career in local government or public service are also strongly encouraged to apply, regardless of major.

**WHY CEMETERY SERVICES?**

Some of the most important public service happens during moments when people need patience, compassion, organization, and clear guidance. Interns will have an opportunity to observe and develop the professional skills necessary to assist community members while learning how the City coordinates services, maintains important public records, communicates with families and service providers, and manages sensitive administrative processes.

The experience can help develop transferable skills in:

- **Empathy & Communication -** Learn how to communicate professionally and compassionately with people experiencing difficult life circumstances.
- **Customer & Community Service -** Develop experience assisting members of the public, understanding their needs, explaining processes, and connecting them with appropriate services or information.
- **Administrative Operations -** Build practical experience with records, databases, documentation, correspondence, scheduling, research, and office procedures.
- **Problem Solving -** Learn how to listen, identify needs, research information, explain options, and assist with resolving questions.
- **Public Service -** Gain firsthand exposure to how a municipal organization operates and how City employees serve their community.

**EXAMPLES OF INTERNSHIP ASSIGNMENTS**

Under the direction and supervision of City staff, assignments may include:

- Greeting and assisting members of the public;

- Responding to routine telephone, email, and in-person inquiries;

- Assisting customers with information regarding available cemetery services and City processes;

- Helping research cemetery and interment records;

- Entering, reviewing, organizing, and verifying information in City records and databases;

- Preparing correspondence, forms, informational materials, spreadsheets, and other documents;

- Assisting with scheduling and coordination of cemetery-related services;

- Supporting records digitization and organization projects;

- Assisting with community outreach or informational projects;

- Observing and learning how City staff coordinate with families, funeral homes, vendors, and other service providers; and

- Completing special projects designed to provide broader exposure to local government operations.


### Qualifications

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**:

- Current enrollment in, or recent graduation from, an accredited college or university.

**Cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA):**

- A minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5 is required. Applicants must provide their most recent unofficial or official transcript showing their cumulative GPA at the time of application.

**Experience**:

- No previous local government or cemetery experience is required.
- Applicants should demonstrate an interest in public service, community service, administrative operations, human services, or a related professional field.

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO ...**

- Has an interest in public service and helping people;
- Demonstrates empathy, patience, maturity, and good judgement;
- Communicates professionally and respectfully;
- Is comfortable interacting with people from different backgrounds and circumstances;
- Understands that cemetery services may involve individuals experiencing grief or emotional situations;
- Is dependable, organized, and willing to learn;
- Can appropriately handle sensitive or confidential information;
- Has basic computer skills and the ability to learn new systems;
- Can follow established procedures while asking questions when guidance is needed; and
- Wants to build meaningful professional experience.

### Supplemental Information

**IMPORTANT APPLICATION INFORMATION AND INSTRUCTIONS**

_The City may work with a student's college or university when the student is seeking academic or internship credit, subject to applicable City requirements._ _Participation in the internship does not guarantee or create entitlement to future paid employment with the City of Redlands._

Candidates must clearly demonstrate through their application material that they meet the minimum qualifications of the position. All properly completed applications will be reviewed, and the most appropriately qualified individuals will be invited to continue in the selection process. Examinations for the positions may consist of any combination of written, performance, and oral exams to evaluate the applicant's skills, training, and experience for the position.

The internship application must be completed and submitted online.  Applicants must list current and past work experience.  Do not indicate “See Resume”.

Proof of education such as but not limited to, university/college transcripts and degrees must be submitted online with your application.  Applicants are responsible for attaching proof of education, certification, and/or license to each position for which they apply.

Please note, the City of Redlands’ preferred method of communication with applicants is via e-mail. As such, please ensure you verify the e-mail address on your application, and check your e-mail frequently, including your spam and junk folders.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a background check (to include a conviction record) and pass a post-offer pre-employment medical examination (which may include a drug/alcohol screening depending upon intern assignment).

For questions regarding this internship program, please contact Sophia Diaz at sdiaz@cityofredlands.orgor Julie Maher at jmaher@cityofredlands.org

title: Design Lead
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.
  • Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. Making it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.
  • Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear
  • Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.
  • Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.
  • Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.
  • Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.
  • Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.
  • Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.
  • Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces and turn loose ideas into compelling product concepts.
  • Strong cross functional communication skills and experience working closely with cross-functional leadership
  • Experience with a variety of user research methods. You know how to get answers from users yourself and help your designers do the same.
  • Excitement about shaping the future of the industry by designing experiences that support meaningful work.
  • Experience leading design across multiple products or surfaces. Two-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Please see below for compensation ranges based on our geographical tiering system recommended by external benchmark data (with example cities listed).

Note: We’ve recently been made aware of a job scam where scammers are posing as Roo employees and conducting fake text interviews. Please note that any communication from @lifeatroo.com is not legitimate. All official Roo communication will always come from @roo.vet.

Core Values
Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!
What to expect from working at Roo!
For permanent, full time employees, we offer:
  • Accelerated growth & learning potential.
  • Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
  • Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.
  • 401K
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.
  • Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
  • Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.
Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.
We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. title: Senior Incident Commander
description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YO

Box is looking for a Senior Incident Commander with a strong Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) skillset and proficient Python for tooling and automation. The GTOC (Global Technical Operations Center) team protects the customer experience, and responsible for detecting customer-impacting failures early, drive rapid mitigation when they occur, coordinate production change risk, and continuously improve how Box runs incidents.

In this role, you will be leading critical and blocker incidents and driving them to swift resolution, while leveraging your software engineering expertise to design and build the tools, automation, and processes that define the next generation of cloud operations. You will shape how we improve manageability, observability, and resiliency of our most critical services, and drive down MTTx so that when incidents happen, we respond faster and smarter than ever before.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and direct live-site Critical and Blocker (and other high severity) incidents from identification and escalation through mitigation and recovery.
  • Triage, refine, and verify the problem and customer-impact statements. Organize the incident bridge, establish clear swim lanes, coordinate SME’s resources, and lead cross-functional Incident Bridges to mitigate issues and restore service quickly.
  • Improve Incident Platform tooling - Optimize templates, automate repetitive response steps, and develop tooling to reduce operational overhead and time to mitigate.
  • Partner with SRE and engineering teams to deepen shared knowledge of Box's dependencies, Tier 1 journeys, failure modes. Work together to implement secure, automated workflows that close operability gaps.
  • Lead daily change reviews of planned changes in Jira, partnering collaboratively with engineering teams to evaluate and minimize change risk.
  • Provide day to day technical expertise and experience to the organization to address issues in globally diverse, 24x7 environments - influencing from policy and procedural decisions to key architectural and tooling insights to improve Box's Incident, Change, and Problem Management engineering capabilities.
  • Lead projects to improve tools and processes related that enhance overall site resiliency, service manageability and observability.
  • Represent GTOC/NOC in problem management, readiness reviews, and reliability in cross functional forums.
  • Turn incident learnings into actionable engineering asks (such as SLOs, signal quality, rollback readiness, dependency docs) to reduce customer impact.
  • Leverage observability APIs, PagerDuty/Jira, and internal services to make response workflows measurable and repeatable.
  • Continuously mentor and uplift the team by running tabletop exercises and improving runbooks.

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • 5+ years in SRE, production operations, reliability engineering, or equivalent high-scale internet/SaaS operations with repeated experience leading or co-leading major production incidents.
  • Demonstrated Incident Commander / Technical Duty Officer (or equivalent) skill: calm under uncertainty, clear communication, ability to delegate, and judgment on when to escalate vs. when to dig deeper.
  • Strong SRE fundamentals: SLIs/SLOs and error budgets (practical use), observability (metrics, logs, traces), golden signals, blameless postmortems, toil reduction, and “you build it, you run it” partnership with product teams.
  • Proficient in Python for automation and tooling (not just one-off scripts): readable code, APIs, packaging or service-style tools others can run, and comfort reviewing others’ automation.
  • Solid Linux/Unix troubleshooting; comfort in multi-tier distributed systems (app, data, network, cloud).
  • Networking literacy sufficient for real incidents (DNS, TLS, load balancing, HTTP, basic routing/firewall concepts).
  • Experience with cloud environments (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure also valued) and container/orchestration concepts (Kubernetes or equivalent).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: exec-ready impact statements, precise Slack/bridge facilitation, and documentation that others can trust under stress.
  • Proven ability to coach and uplift others — training, mentoring, runbook quality, drills.

Preferred skills

  • Experience in a 24x7 NOC / GTOC / follow-the-sun operations center, or partnering closely with one.
  • Hands-on with Prometheus-compatible observability (e.g. Chronosphere, Grafana), distributed tracing(e.g. SignalFx), synthetic monitoring (e.g. Catchpoint), and PagerDuty (or similar).
  • Experience improving incident tooling (ChatOps, workflow automation, status/comms templates, drill frameworks).
  • Familiarity with change management under pressure (emergency changes, break-glass, CAB/async approval patterns).
  • Additional languages or tooling useful for ops automation (Go, shell, Terraform, CI/CD).
  • Prior work mapping dependency graphs, service catalogs, or Tier 1 journey documentation.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

title: Data Analyst - Finance Operations
description:
Jetstar thrives on innovation. We're always looking for proactive professionals to help our business work smarter and more efficiently. You will be encouraged to think innovatively whilst developing and maintaining best practice.

The Data Analyst – Finance Operations plays a key role in accelerating the adoption of AI, automation and data-driven ways of working across Finance Operations, supporting Engineering, Cabin Crew, Flight Operations and Airports. This role drives process simplification, improves data quality and delivers self-service analytics solutions that enable faster, more informed decision-making. Through these insights, the role helps shape outcomes for Finance teams, the Chief Operating Officer and the Jetstar Operations Leadership Team (JOLT). More than a traditional analyst position, this opportunity is suited to someone who is equally comfortable engaging with Finance stakeholders and working with data, and who is passionate about building solutions that transform the way people work.

The core responsibilities of this role are:

  • Drive AI, automation and process improvement initiatives across Finance Operations.
  • Build and maintain low-code/no-code solutions using tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate and the broader Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Develop data pipelines, models to facilitate self-service reporting, analytics and workflow solutions that enable Finance and Operations teams to make faster, more informed decisions.
  • Identify manual, repetitive and inefficient processes and design practical solutions that improve efficiency, control and data quality.
  • Explore and apply AI and Copilot capabilities to solve real business problems, including opportunities for intelligent automation and AI agents where appropriate.
  • Improve the way Finance data is captured, governed and used, helping create reliable and reusable data foundations for reporting and automation.
  • Support transformation from idea through to implementation, including prototyping, testing, documentation, training and user adoption.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging AI, analytics and automation tools
  • Support user adoption through training, documentation and stakeholder engagement

To be considered for this role, you will have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, Data Science, Information Systems or related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience in data analytics, business intelligence or finance transformation roles
  • Experience working in Finance, Finance Transformation, Finance Operations business improvement or a similar environment, with a strong understanding of Finance processes and business needs (essential)
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building solutions, rather than solely analysing or reporting on data
  • Proficiency in Power BI or equivalent BI tooling (essential)
  • Hands on experience with AI tools (Co-Pilot preferred) and automation platforms (Microsoft Fabric suite of products) is desirable.

title: Mortgage Loan Originator Assistant
description:
Partners 1st Federal Credit Union will provide U with a competitive salary, paid illness, personal time, vacation, holidays, medical/dental/vision/life insurance, generous 401(k) retirement plan with company matches, tuition reimbursement, weekly pay, and a professional and fun office working environment.


Are U willing to provide our members with your enthusiasm for service, integrity to become their trusted financial partner, create and support quality teamwork among staff and able to apply your knowledge, skills and experience with member service and problem solving to accomplish important and meaningful work.


This position is for U if you are a self-motivated, detail-oriented, organized person with a strong understanding of mortgage products and regulations and are able to work at our Directors Row location, Fort Wayne, IN, full-time, 40hrs/wk, with a schedule of:

Mon-Fri: 8:00am-5:00pm

There can be some flexibility with the schedule, as far as daily schedule, if needed.



Role

This Mortgage Loan Officer Assistant role will primarily assist our Mortgage Loan Originator(s) (MLO) with incoming 1st mortgage applications. The Mortgage Loan Officer Assistant will be primarily based in-office while the MLO is in the community meeting with prospective and existing referral partners. The assistant will be available to review new applications timely and analyze credit history, income, assets, and overall loan opportunities. When the MLO(s) is unavailable, the assistant will be the primary contact for the 1st mortgage applications. While the Mortgage Loan Officer Assistant will contribute to the overall mortgage sales goal for the credit union, they are not held accountable to an individual sales goal. Due to the nature of the role, there is no commission.


Major Duties and Responsibilities

40% Assists and supports Mortgage Loan Originator(s) (MLO) with incoming applications, taking direction day-to-day from MLO(s) on potential borrowers and loan files that need attention. Assist the MLO(s) with incoming inquires and various needs to ensure they are able to spend time out of the office attracting new business.


20% Receives and screens 2nd mortgage loan applications from frontline staff, evaluates and underwrites loan requests using judgement and discretion in making decisions to satisfy the member needs. Conducts 2nd mortgage loan interview and gathers all financial data to support the loan application. Responsible for communicating 2nd mortgage loan information to members and frontline staff as needed. Maintains communication with mortgage members via email, phone, and mail from application to closing and post-closing. Loans outside of guidelines or approval parameters are escalated to the leadership of the mortgage departments with a recommendation as to the loan decision for each loan. Responsible for communicating 2nd mortgage loan decisions to frontline staff and members directly. Must have ability to discuss loan denials, loan alternatives, and rate computation in a clear, concise, and courteous manner for all loan products.


15% Contact borrowers to request supporting documents requested by Mortgage Loan Originator(s), following up regularly until all items are received.


10% Assists the origination team in preparing marketing materials for referral partners. This may involve putting together gift baskets and raffle prizes, coming up with ideas for promotional materials and thank you gifts, planning events, and additional support.


5% When necessary, provide potential borrowers with interest rate quotes and closing cost quotes. Also provide members with basic loan program information.


5% When necessary, assist members with the completion of new loan applications and handle as the MLO assigned to that loan. Responsibilities in taking a new loan application are not limited to; coordinate the collection of documentation, including credit reports, run automated underwriting, request supporting documents from members, and prepare the file for processing.


5% Stay informed on changes in the industry and the local real estate market(s) in which the CU lends.


Performs other related job duties as assigned


Must comply with all company policies and procedures, applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, the Patriot Act, and the Office of Foreign Assets Control.


This role requires behaviors and actions that reflect the credit union's culture, mission, and core values through exceptional service that supports both employees and members. A strong commitment to service excellence and member-focused solutions is essential to the success of this position and the credit union.

description:

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Your Impact

You will be part of a high-impact engineering team that develops embedded software for Axon devices, ensuring critical evidence is captured during mission-essential moments for our customers. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented software and firmware engineers and contribute to the creation of next-generation public safety products, including body-worn cameras, in-car audio-video systems, TASERs, wireless microphones, and more.

As a Firmware Validation Engineer I, you are a key quality voice for one or more Axon products, partnering with firmware, software, and hardware engineering to ship products customers can trust. You'll own testing for your product area with increasing independence, contribute to departmental testing standards, and help leadership make informed calls on coverage, bug severity, and release risk. Your work directly shapes product quality, customer trust, and release timelines.

Location: Scottsdale, AZ
Reports to: Software Engineering Manager
Direct Reports: N/A

What You'll Do:

  • Own execution of release regression (manual and automated), exploratory testing, as well as impacted areas for individual new features, scoping coverage to risk and release timelines.
  • Design and maintain the test strategy for assigned products/domains: test case creation and prioritization, and traceability from requirements (PRD/Jira) through to test cases in a test management system (e.g., Zephyr Scale).
  • Partner with engineering under the shift-left model: review dev-authored test plans and acceptance tests, flag coverage gaps, and own the testing that engineering can't do alone (regression, exploratory, and specialized/environmental/vehicle testing).
  • Investigate and document defects; represent QA in bug triage, pushing back on premature “won’t fix” calls with reproducible evidence and customer-impact data.
  • Lead release-readiness reporting including feature quality reports, test execution status, and production-vs-staging escape analysis to inform go/no-go decisions.
  • Identify and drive test tooling and process improvements (dashboards for regression/performance monitoring, new test-equipment integrations, AI-assisted test case generation) to increase coverage and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, PM/TPM, and hardware/RF labs to resolve scheduling, access, and documentation gaps that block testing.
  • Manage multiple concurrent test cycles and releases with minimal oversight, setting priorities across competing deadlines.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in software, firmware, or hardware quality assurance / validation engineering, ideally on complex, multi-component products.
  • Experience with embedded or connected-device products (firmware and hardware-software integration).
  • Hands-on experience with test case design, test execution, and automated testing methodologies.
  • Working experience within a test management and requirements-traceability practice, using Jira, Zephyr Scale (or equivalent), and log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk).
  • Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python or similar) and CI/CD-integrated test frameworks.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Familiarity with hardware and environmental test methods: RF, GPS/GNSS, environmental chambers, and connectivity (LTE/Wi-Fi) testing is preferred.
  • Experience using AI tools for test case generation, traceability, and test data analysis is highly preferred.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all

  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support

title: Inventory Supervisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Under the general direction of the Purchasing Manager, the Inventory Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and supervising daily inventory control, material handling, shipping, and receiving operations. This position provides leadership, direction, and support to inventory personnel while ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient management of direct components, raw materials, and consumables.

The Inventory Supervisor is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy within the Global Shop system, coordinating material flow to support production schedules, overseeing receiving and shipping activities, and ensuring compliance with established inventory, material handling, and safety procedures. The Supervisor serves as a key point of contact between Inventory, Purchasing, Production, Quality, and other departments to ensure materials are available, properly documented, and ready for use.

This position is also responsible for employee training and development, workload coordination, inventory audits, identifying process improvements, resolving inventory discrepancies, and supporting departmental goals and continuous improvement initiatives.

POSITION DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of inventory, shipping, receiving, and material handling personnel.
  • Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and support to inventory team members to ensure departmental goals and expectations are met.
  • Assign and prioritize daily work based on production requirements, inventory needs, shipping/receiving demands, and business priorities.
  • Train new and existing employees on inventory procedures, material handling, data entry, system transactions, safety requirements, and company policies.
  • Monitor employee performance and provide ongoing feedback, coaching, and support to promote productivity, accountability, and professional development.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records for direct components, materials, and consumables within the Global Shop system.
  • Monitor inventory levels, usage, and production requirements to help ensure materials are available when needed and minimize shortages or excess inventory.
  • Submit purchase requisitions for consumables and other materials based on production schedules, inventory levels, lead times, and anticipated requirements.
  • Oversee shipping and receiving activities to ensure materials are received, inspected, documented, labeled, stored, and issued appropriately.
  • Ensure all inventory transactions, receipts, transfers, adjustments, and material movements are accurately recorded and completed in a timely manner.
  • Conduct and/or coordinate cycle counts, physical inventory activities, and inventory audits; investigate and resolve discrepancies.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to inventory accuracy, material usage, shortages, damage, obsolescence, and incoming material quality.
  • Partner with Quality personnel to identify, segregate, document, and communicate nonconforming or questionable materials.
  • Collaborate with Production to ensure materials are available, staged, and properly prepared to support production schedules.
  • Work closely with Purchasing to communicate material requirements, shortages, supplier issues, and changes in demand.
  • Monitor material flow throughout the facility and ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and organization of inventory.
  • Ensure inventory areas, storage locations, and material handling practices are maintained in an organized, safe, and efficient manner.
  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment as required and ensure team members follow applicable safety procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with company policies, inventory procedures, safety requirements, and material handling standards.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and improvement of inventory control procedures and work instructions.
  • Support the Purchasing Manager with inventory reporting, audits, metrics, investigations, and other departmental initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain inventory-related reports and communicate key issues, trends, and performance indicators to management.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, material flow, productivity, and overall departmental efficiency.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings and projects involving Purchasing, Production, Quality, Operations, and other departments.
  • Address day-to-day inventory issues and escalate significant operational, material, or personnel concerns to management as appropriate.
  • Assist with employee scheduling, coverage, and workload planning to maintain adequate departmental support.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Perform other duties, projects, and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Director, Membership Planning - Membership Value & LTV
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

We're looking for a Director, Membership Value & LTV to help us understand what drives the long-term value of our subscribers and turn those insights into better commercial decisions.

You will connect performance across acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetization to build a clear view of subscriber and cohort economics. You’ll identify what is driving performance, where we have the biggest opportunities to improve LTV, and help teams prioritize the actions that will have the greatest impact.

Reporting to the VP, Membership Performance, you’ll work across Growth, Lifecycle, Curation, Product, Engineering, Content, Business Development, Finance, CDI (Center for Data and Insights), and Regional teams. This role is for a commercial operator who is highly analytical and deeply understands subscription businesses - someone who can get into the data, form a clear point of view, and influence decisions across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build an integrated view of subscriber value across acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, monetization, and reactivation.
  • Understand how acquisition source, offers, markets, content, and subscriber behavior translate into retention, monetization, and long-term value.
  • Diagnose changes in LTV, cohort quality, payback, ARPU, churn, retention, and engagement, separating longer-term trends from short-term or one-time effects.
  • Identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities to improve subscriber value across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, win-back, pricing, payments, and the broader Crunchyroll ecosystem.
  • Turn cohort analysis, experimentation, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior insights into clear recommendations on where we should invest, what we should change, and which opportunities will have the greatest impact.
  • Partner with CDI and Finance on the data, definitions, measurement, and analysis needed to answer key business questions and measure initiatives against subscriber value, not just activity or short-term performance.
  • Work with Product, Lifecycle, Curation, Content, Business Development, and Regional teams to evaluate opportunities, shape priorities, and understand how content, product capabilities, promotions, pricing, payments, and other experiences affect subscriber economics.
  • Lead membership value reviews and give senior leaders a clear point of view on what is happening, why it matters, and what we should do about it.
  • Bring learnings into Membership Strategy, Commercial Planning, and functional and regional roadmaps, building a consistent approach to managing subscriber value globally while accounting for differences across markets.
  • Build stronger capabilities across the organization in cohort analysis, value measurement, and connecting subscriber behavior to commercial outcomes.

We are considering applicants available to work a hybrid schedule, with three days each week onsite at our Dallas office.

About You

  • 12+ years of experience in growth, commercial strategy, membership strategy, or business operations, including significant experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business.
  • Demonstrated experience improving subscriber economics across acquisition, engagement, retention, monetization, and lifetime value.
  • Strong commercial judgment and analytical fluency - able to get into the data, understand what is driving performance, and turn insights into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Deep understanding of subscription metrics and cohort economics, including retention, churn, ARPU, payback, engagement, and LTV.
  • Experience using cohort analysis and customer behavior to identify and prioritize opportunities across the subscriber lifecycle.
  • Track record of influencing Product, Marketing, Finance, Analytics, and other teams to move from insight to action.
  • Strong executive communication skills and sound judgment, including the ability to simplify complex analysis and make clear recommendations.
  • Experience in streaming, OTT, digital media, entertainment, gaming, or another consumer subscription business strongly preferred.
  • Top-tier consulting or strategy experience and an MBA are pluses.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
  • Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
  • Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Health Saving Account HSA program
  • Health care and dependent care FSA
  • 401(k) plan, with employer match
  • Employer paid commuter benefit
  • Support program for new parents
  • Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

  • Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

  • Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

title: Run Perception Graduate Internship, R&D - Winter 2027
description:
Who We Are:

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

  • Word is Bond

  • Champion Heart
    • We give our all in everything we do
  • There is no “I” in Run
    • We stay generous with our humanity
  • Keep Moving
    • We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!

We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.


Brooks Internship Program:

Brooks Running hosts internships at our Seattle HQ offices to provide hands-on, meaningful work experience to further enhance your education and professional aptitude. Our interns gain exposure to real work, and projects while working side by side with Brooks employees and leadership. If chosen for this role, you will embark on 6 months of learning, professional development, and exposure to the Brooks brand and culture.

Internship Details:

Duration: 6 months

Internship Target Start: January 12, 2026 Compensation: $33.00/hr

Location: Seattle, HQ Schedule: 40 hours / week

Please apply if you can commit to the duration, salary and location for this opportunity.

Your Opportunity:

Our Run Perception Team is seeking a master’s graduate intern to work at our Seattle HQ offices. As the Run Perception Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in product research at the leading running brand – Brooks Sports, Inc. Your primary responsibilities will be to assist Run Perception Researchers as they collect information from product testers across the nation to contribute key perceptual information regarding fit, performance, and design. This information is critical for our multi-departmental infrastructure, including Development, Design, and Merchandising, to ensure that performance integrity of our product meets the needs of our end consumers. You will also gain knowledge on how perceptual feedback influences design and development of athletic products at Brooks.

With the Run Perception Team being part of our Development team, you will learn how to work closely with the Developers on building product based off insights collected not only from the Run Perception Team, but also from other collaborators across the company.


Your Impact (Responsibilities):

  • Understand athletic product design features and components, and how they influence fit, feel, and ride.
  • Conduct internal and external perception testing data collections for inline footwear and the sourcing team. This entails targeted participant recruitment based on the product goals and consumer base, creation of perception surveys that test the hypotheses at hand, analysis of qualitative results, and synthesis of data into a clear point of view highlighting how the product is performing.
  • Compile and present scientific reports via PowerPoint, summarizing findings based on runner feedback that are delivered to product teams for use in product improvement.
  • Use your graduate-level research skills to conduct Run Perception studies that lead to innovative testing procedures and optimization of product for all who run.
  • Use your advanced data analytics skills to mine data in our Tableau historical dashboards containing over 3 million words of perception testing feedback for product over the last six years to recommend product improvements based on identified opportunities.
  • Use AI-powered tools to help analyze and summarize wear test feedback at both the individual and historical dataset level, uncovering meaningful patterns and insights that strengthen product storytelling and recommendations.
  • Develop loyal, engaging relationships with our product testers and the Brooks community.
  • Assist with the management of Brooks perception testing community social media account on Facebook with timely and accurate responses to participants and the creation of engaging content for the group. Other duties as assigned.

Project:

As a part of your experience as a graduate intern at Brooks, you will have the opportunity to complete a project under the support and supervision of your manager. Details of your project will be finalized once you arrive at Brooks based on your interests and the needs of the business. You will use your ever-growing analytical skillset as a graduate student to prepare a thoughtful and elevated project. Weave your learnings from your graduate courses into your work to challenge yourself and benefit Brooks. You will present your work and findings to senior leadership at Brooks at the end of your internship, to hone in on your research, recommendation, and presentation skills.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree with a background in biomechanics, kinesiology, and/or exercise science or an equivalent analytical field.
  • Willing to commit to the intern position for six months onsite in Seattle, WA
  • Willingness to learn and gain hands-on experience.
  • Able to commit to up to 40 hours a week to be physically present at HQ.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating effective listening through concise and clear verbal and written communication.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Well-developed quantitative skills with an aptitude for report-building, data mining, and interpretation.
  • Product creation or running retail experience is ideal.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented with an emphasis on quality work products. Always looking to improve our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary.
  • Must be able to collaborate in a team-oriented environment.
  • Understanding our product line and our competitors desired.
  • Experience using AI for data analysis support or brainstorming desired.
  • Embrace Brooks values!

Sign-on bonus to provide financial support before first paycheck
Housing Subsidy
Travel Fee Coverage

The Associate Dean of Alumni Affairs and Development serves as the chief development officer for Cornell Law School and leads the school's comprehensive development and alumni engagement strategy and serves as a critical bridge between the Law School and the university's Alumni Affairs and Development division. The Associate Dean will partner with a highly engaged dean who is deeply committed to philanthropy and alumni engagement while building on the momentum of Cornell's recently completed record-setting campaign. title: Associate Director, Foundation and Corporate Relations
description:
Cato seeks an Associate Director, Foundation and Corporate Relations to help grow philanthropic support from a portfolio of corporate and foundation partners. The ideal candidate will have at least five years of fundraising experience with the ability to manage relationships independently and contribute at a high level to proposal and grant strategy. Reporting to the Director of Foundation and Corporate Relations, they will own a portfolio of these relationships, working closely with the Director on strategy and helping to manage the pipeline as a whole.


The position is based at Cato’s headquarters in Washington, DC, and requires occasional travel and work on weekends and evenings. Exceptional candidates may be considered for a virtual position.


The projected salary range for this role is $80,000–$115,000 per year. Compensation is based on the successful candidate’s educational background, experience, and skills.


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION, YOU MUST COMPLETE THE TALENT MARKET APPLICATION!


About Cato


The Cato Institute is a public policy research organization—a think tank—dedicated to the principles of individual liberty, limited government, free markets, and peace. Its scholars and analysts conduct independent, nonpartisan research on a wide range of policy issues.


Founded in 1977, Cato owes its name to Cato’s Letters, a series of essays published in 18th-century England that presented a vision of a society free from excessive government power. Those essays inspired the architects of the American Revolution. And the simple, timeless principles of that revolution—individual liberty, limited government, and free markets—turn out to be even more powerful in today’s world of global markets and unprecedented access to information than Jefferson or Madison could have imagined. Social and economic freedom is not just the best policy for a free people, it is the indispensable framework for the future.


The Cato Institute is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Steward and grow a portfolio of corporate and foundation supporters through regular, substantive engagement that strengthens relationships and increases philanthropic support
  • Stay closely informed on Cato’s research, policy work, and events to proactively connect partners with content aligned with their interests and priorities
  • Apply a sophisticated understanding of which policy areas are most relevant to each partner to guide outreach, engagement, and proposal strategy
  • Coordinate meetings, briefings, and events connecting supporters with Cato scholars
  • Work with teams across the Institute to craft compelling proposals and reports that accurately communicate Cato’s work and impact
  • Identify, qualify, and research prospective foundation and corporate partners
  • Represent Cato at networking events, following up with new contacts to advance relationships
  • Help manage the foundation and corporate pipeline as a whole, in partnership with the Director, including building and executing moves-management plans, soliciting gifts, and maintaining a comprehensive calendar of proposal and reporting deadlines and accurate records in Salesforce
