  • Commitment to BGCP’s mission and vision, and to supporting TK–8 youth
  • High school diploma or equivalent (required)
  • Experience building relationships with diverse youth communities and constituents
  • Ability to motivate through positive reinforcement
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to navigate and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • One year of experience working with TK–8 youth (preferred)
  • Spanish fluency is a plus

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT
The usual and customary methods of performing the job’s functions require the following physical demands: occasional lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling; some climbing and balancing; and some stooping, kneeling, bending at the waist, reaching overhead, crouching, squatting, and/or crawling. The role also requires significant fine finger dexterity and near vision acuity. The position may occasionally involve lifting or carrying objects up to 25 pounds. Generally, the job requires approximately 20% sitting and 80% walking or standing. The work environment noise level is typically moderate but may occasionally be louder. LOCATION

Redwood City, CA

WORK SCHEDULE

  • 24-29 hours per week

title: Mechanical Technician

title: Project Manager
description:

Join our Team - Your career journey starts here – not just a job, but a future.

What You’ll Lead and Deliver

  • Plan and manage fabrication activities, ensuring alignment with project specifications, drawings, schedules, and quality requirements.
  • Monitor project costs, progress, and resource utilization to ensure adherence to the approved budget.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong decision-making capabilities, supported by analytical thinking, sound judgment, practical experience, and business understanding.

title: Remote Sensing Data Scientist
description:
About the role

Muon Space is building a family of infrared imaging missions designed for global wildfire detection and monitoring, weather and cloud characterization, and space-based environmental monitoring. Muon's IR Data Products team builds the analytics system that processes the data from our spacecraft's custom multispectral imaging instruments into data products and analytics for diverse end-user stakeholders from these missions. We are seeking a Geospatial Data Scientist to join this team with a focus on building derived data products from Muon's FireSat and Space-Based Environmental Monitoring (SBEM) missions.

This role will be a hands-on contributor to the development of derived data products from Muon's IR data missions. You will dive deep into real-world data from brand new imaging systems, prototype and productionize algorithms that turn Level-1 imagery into higher-level derived products, and write production-ready code that feeds directly into customer-facing services. Working alongside senior scientists and product owners on the IR Data Products team, you will build expertise across both missions while contributing to product design, validation, and documentation. This is a high-impact, multi-mission role that sits at the intersection of rigorous Earth observation science and fast-moving product development, and is well-suited for someone who thrives on hands-on technical work and cross-functional collaboration.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our Denver, CO office three days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Build derived data products from Muon's infrared imaging missions, spanning Muon’s IR programs
  • Implement and improve scalable algorithms for processing, transforming, and analyzing multispectral infrared imagery into derived geospatial products.
  • Contribute to derived product design and roadmap under the direction of senior scientists and product owners on the IR Data team.
  • Contribute to technical and customer-facing design documents for derived products, supporting alignment between internal capabilities and external stakeholder requirements.
  • Support engagement with customer technical stakeholders including Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs), customer questions, and program meetings
  • Write production-ready code that integrates into customer-facing data product pipelines and operational services.
  • Contribute to the scientific quality, quantitative validation, and integrity of derived products across Muon’s IR missions.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineers, calibration scientists, and instrument engineers to design, build, and maintain operational data product services.
  • Learn new topics as needed (e.g., sensor geometry and characterization, georeferencing techniques, wildfire and environmental monitoring applications, cloud-native geospatial data engineering).

Qualifications

  • Degree & Experience: PhD; or MS with 3+ years industry experience; or BS with 5+ years industry experience
  • Geospatial Processing: Hands-on experience building geospatial data products, particularly from new or novel imaging instruments.
  • Scientific Rigor: Demonstrated experience applying first principles to solve complex problems.
  • Sensor Data: Experience working with real-world data from new or novel imaging instruments
  • Software Development: Strong skills in Python-based development and analysis
  • Geospatial Technical Stack: Strong Python development skills utilizing standard geospatial formats and libraries (e.g., COGs, Xarray, GDAL).
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of collaborating across distributed, interdisciplinary teams (scientists, engineers, product).
  • Distributed Team: Ability to work with a distributed, interdisciplinary team (scientists, engineers, data support)
  • Startup Adaptability: Ability to prioritize, pivot, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrared sensing: Experience processing multispectral or infrared satellite imagery
  • Domain Expertise: Domain expertise in wildfire monitoring, meteorology, weather, environmental remote sensing, or related Earth observation applications
  • Mission & Operational Lifecycle: Experience supporting satellite mission product development, commissioning, early operations, or delivering operational pipelines to external customers.
  • ML/AI: Demonstrated experience applying ML/DL and advanced image processing to remote sensing data
  • Cloud Architecture: Familiarity with cloud-native geospatial workflows and large-scale data processing (AWS preferred).
  • Technical Documentation: Experience authoring technical design documents, product specifications, or algorithm theoretical basis documents (ATBDs).

Salary

The salary range for this role is $171,000 - $191,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. title: Multifamily Fee Compliance Expert
description:

We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

ApartmentIQ is hiring a Solutions Consultant to lead our work with multifamily operators on fee transparency and compliance. This person brings hands-on experience with how apartment fees are set, marketed and reviewed, and uses it to help customers advertise fees accurately and consistently across every channel.

Fee regulation in rental housing is evolving quickly, and operators need a clear view of how their fees appear to renters. In this role, you'll lead customer demonstrations, serve as the subject-matter expert in sales conversations, and research regulatory requirements that shape our product.

  • Develop educational content for Sales and Marketing, including guides, one-pagers and webinars, and represent ApartmentIQ at industry events.
  • Share customer feedback and unmet needs with the product team.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in multifamily with a property management company, owner-operator or REIT.

Nice to have

  • Paralegal certificate, JD or compliance credential.
  • Pre-sales, solutions consulting or other customer-facing SaaS experience.
  • Established relationships across apartment industry associations.
  • Experience supporting multi-state portfolios.

Why Choose Us

  • Remote-First: We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
  • Competitive Compensation: We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive a competitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
  • Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.
  • Your Health Matters: Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.
  • Peace of Mind (On Us): We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
  • Protection for Your Whole Crew: Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.

title: Senior Mission Integration Engineer

title: Water Quality Sampling Technician - Durham VA Medical Center
description:

I-2-I Solutions performs water quality testing supporting water management programs at VA Medical Centers across North Carolina and Virginia. As an Environmental / Water Sampling Technician, you will collect water samples, perform field parameter readings, and complete required compliance documentation.

Location
  • Durham VA Medical Center – 508 Fulton Street, Durham, NC 27705 (48 samples/quarter)

Schedule
Part-time and quarterly, with on-demand support as needed. Sampling visits occur on a quarterly schedule during normal VA business hours, with a 1-week advance notification before each visit.

  • Sample Collection: Collect first-draw potable hot/cold water samples, ice/dispenser samples, cooling tower water samples, and retest samples following CDC and ISO 11731 procedures.

  • Resampling Support: re-sampling within 5 working days following positive detections.

Facility Access
Because the work is performed inside VA medical facilities, access requires background clearance and badging approval in coordination with facility points of contact prior to performing site work.

title: OneStream Consultant
description:

title: Career Mentor
description:
About the Organization

Center for Community Alternatives (CCA) supports and builds power with people across New York State who have been affected by mass incarceration, criminalization and community disinvestment. Through a statewide network of direct services, advocacy and organizing, and by supporting the leadership of directly-impacted people, we advance civil and human rights for all New Yorkers. CCA works to build a world where everyone has what they need to thrive.

Why Join the Team?

At CCA, we are committed to fair transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive market-informed compensation. The successful candidate's salary is determined by the combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, and geography. Our goal is to continue to make CCA one of the most desirable nonprofit places at which to work, and in part, recognize the importance of work-life balance.

CCA’s Youth Services’ Education and Employment Department is seeking a qualified positive youth development professional to deliver employment services to justice-impacted youth.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Outreach and Client Facing Services (75%)

  • Outreach to and maintain engagement with participants across all departmental programming
  • Conduct intakes with new participants and document youth’s contact information, employment experience, and employment plans
  • Assist participants with action plans, transitional plans, and address employment barriers (resume, cover letter, certifications, photo ID, birth certificate)
  • Maintain contact with subcontracted facilitators for participant progress and support areas
  • Complete weekly outreach goals for participants enrolled in the Education and Employment Department’s programs
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners, including subcontracted facilitators, regarding participant engagement and develop participant outreach strategies and share with the Career Readiness Coordinator
  • Develop and maintain relationships with subcontracted, grassroots partner organizations
  • Support Transition Coordinators from the NextGen Network program in building relationships with youth reentering from detention
  • Work with Transition Coordinators to deliver high-quality enrichment, restorative justice and career pathways workshops through youth development and trauma-informed best practices
  • Support reentering youth connect with community resources and subcontracted partner organizations
  • Connect with youth within 48 hours of their release and provide resource packets and information of resources
  • Support youth and their families engage and work towards reentry milestones
Administration, Data Collection and Reporting (25%)
  • Report participant demographic, programmatic, and milestone data in all internal databases, including QuickBase; ensure Director of Education and Career Readiness Coordinator is updated regularly on participant engagement
  • Generate and save all participant documentation group and 1:1 notes; intakes; outreach attempts and contacts; resumes and cover letters; save and track in all internal trackers, including Quickbase
  • Complete internal weekly reports, as required by Director of Career Readiness.
  • Attend and participate in weekly department meetings.
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in youth development, social work, criminal justice or related human services field required.
  • Strong interest in juvenile justice issues and awareness of positive youth development best practices required.
  • Strong written/oral communication and advocacy skills.
  • Excellent networking, writing and organizational skills Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Suite and other online platforms Strong interpersonal and team building skills.
  • Experience working directly with justice-involved youth a strong plus Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

ALL APPLICANTS MUST SUBMIT COVER LETTER WITH RESUME.

  • 12 paid holidays per year
  • 20 days of earned time off (ETO) for full-time staff, with the ability to use it after 90-days of employment.
  • Time off is earned starting on your first day.
  • 7 days of paid sick time
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Program

title: Production Planner II
description:
Production Planner II

Company Overview

At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

Mitsubishi Power is hiring a Production Planner II in our Savannah Machinery Works location. The Production Planner II will coordinate the production process to achieve an on-time project completion based on contractual requirements and operational lead-times.

Key Responsibilities
  • Demonstrates our core competencies: Action oriented, change champion, customer-focused, developing self & others, and ownership.
  • Read production schedule, customer order, work order, shipping order, or requisition to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed.
  • Create work orders and schedule the releases of work orders to designated work centers.
  • Perform scheduling of released orders in the shop floor control system, manage work-in-process (WIP) and assist with physical movement of product throughout the entire manufacturing process.
  • Sort and control materials or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined shop floor priorities.
  • Coordinate with purchasing and inventory control the expediting of late arriving purchased material that can affect scheduled product completion and subsequent deliveries.
  • Confer with production management to resolve problems affecting production schedules.
  • Communicate program priorities for out-sourced production work.
  • Coordinate the final shipment of product with supervisors, project managers and shipping/receiving personnel.
  • Advises the Production Control Supervisor and Manufacturing Manager of anticipated problems, material shortages, engineering changes and/or equipment failures or major non-conformance of in-process product.
  • Check for planning errors during production and recommend corrective action.
  • Prepare purchase orders to maintain inventories of raw materials and finished products.
  • Evaluates written data, such as job orders, product specifications and operations sheets, parts and materials inventory lists, and machine and worker production rates, to establish efficient allocation and scheduling of parts, materials, machines, and sequences of operation and workflow.
  • Maintain inventory records.
  • Perform other such duties as may be required.

Requirements
  • Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or equivalent and at least 5 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Forklift operation and overhead crane operation certificates preferred.
  • Language Skills: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Computer Skills: Basic personal computer skills including electronic mail, word processing, spreadsheet, and advanced database knowledge of MPR, ERP and BOM processes.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis and must not require employer immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Why Should You Apply?
  • Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
  • Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
  • Committed to quality products and services.
  • Great working environment and culture.
  • Employee Appreciation Programs and Event.

Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Sr Strategic Sourcing Spec
description:
As a Sr Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) in India and EMEA or Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) categories supporting Honeywell manufacturing operations in India and partially APAC.

You will partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Integrated Supply Chain, Finance, and Project Management teams to deliver productivity, improve supplier performance, mitigate commercial and supply risks, and support the successful execution of capital investment and operational reliability initiatives.

You will apply your manufacturing and strategic sourcing experience to manage complex supplier engagements, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate commercial agreements, and implement category strategies that deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for CAPEX / MRO categories supporting manufacturing operations
  • Support the execution of capital investment projects in India and EMEA region, including manufacturing expansion, capacity growth, automation, modernization, and equipment replacement initiatives
  • Lead sourcing activities related to manufacturing expansion projects in Pune and Hyderabad
  • Manage end-to-end sourcing activities, including requirements review, market analysis, supplier identification, RFx execution, bid evaluation, negotiation, supplier recommendation, contracting, and implementation
  • Lead sourcing activities for capital equipment, production machinery, automation systems, manufacturing technologies, installation services, commissioning support, and related technical services
  • Develop and implement sourcing strategies for MRO categories, including industrial spare parts, repair and maintenance services, OEM components, industrial consumables, technical services, tools, and reliability-related requirements
  • Partner with Engineering and Project Management teams to align sourcing plans with technical specifications, project schedules, budgets, and implementation requirements
  • Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance teams to support equipment availability, operational continuity, and manufacturing reliability
  • Drive productivity through competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, demand management, value engineering, specification optimization, supplier consolidation, and total cost of ownership analysis
  • Conduct supply market analysis and supplier benchmarking to support sourcing decisions
  • Monitor supplier performance across quality, delivery, cost, service, responsiveness, and compliance
  • Lead supplier performance reviews and establish corrective action and continuous improvement plans as needed
  • Evaluate supplier capabilities, capacity, financial health, commercial position, and supply continuity risks
  • Develop and execute mitigation plans for supplier, contractual, commercial, and project-execution risks
  • Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, payment terms, productivity commitments, warranties, service levels, liability, and other contractual requirements
  • Ensure compliance with Honeywell sourcing policies, ethical requirements, approval processes, and contract governance standards
  • Support contract development, execution, administration, supplier compliance, and resolution of commercial issues
  • Maintain and support accurate sourcing plans, project updates, savings forecasts, supplier information, risk documentation, supporting records, annual productivity, working capital, cost optimization, and supply continuity objectives
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders and gain alignment on sourcing recommendations, supplier selection, and commercial decisions
  • Promote standard sourcing processes, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement across the India CAPEX and MRO portfolio

CAPEX strategy includes categories such as processing machinery, test & analytical, automation and process controls, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning), material handling, packaging and other industrial equipment, supplies & services Meanwhile, MRO strategy includes categories such as OEM spare parts, pumps, pipes, valves and fittings, motors, bearings, power transmission, pneumatics, hydraulics, hardware, fasteners, industrial gases, chemicals, lubricants, cutting tools, hand and power tools, electrical supplies, and other industrial materials.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline
  • 7 to 10 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Category Management, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience working in or directly supporting a manufacturing environment
  • Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for CAPEX and/or MRO categories
  • Experience sourcing capital equipment, production machinery, industrial equipment, maintenance services, spare parts, technical services, and/or industrial consumables
  • Experience leading competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations
  • Experience negotiating supplier contracts, commercial terms, payment terms, warranties, and service-level requirements
  • Experience managing supplier relationships and driving supplier performance improvements
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable cost reduction, productivity, working capital, or total cost improvements
  • Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, and commercial decision-making skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Integrated Supply Chain, and Project Management stakeholders
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English within a global business environment

WE VALUE

  • Engineering background combined with strategic sourcing or procurement experience
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and industrial supply markets and possessing strong project management and organizational skills
  • Strong knowledge of MRO sourcing, industrial spare parts, maintenance services, OEM requirements, industrial supplies, and reliability-related procurement
  • Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, manufacturing expansion, automation, modernization, capacity growth, or equipment replacement projects
  • Experience managing sourcing activities from specification development through supplier selection, contracting, delivery, installation, commissioning support, and project closeout
  • Experience applying total cost of ownership, should-cost analysis, cost modeling, value engineering, and cost-benefit analysis
  • Experience using supplier scorecards, business reviews, corrective actions, and continuous improvement plans
  • Knowledge of contract governance, commercial risk management, supplier compliance, and sourcing controls
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, as well as influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
  • Experience working across global and regional teams in a matrixed organization
  • Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience mind set
  • Knowledge of eSourcing, spend analytics, contract management, and procurement systems.
